Hi friends, I’m writing to follow up on the email I sent you a few days ago about our April fundraising.
We’re trying to boost our numbers by midnight on April 30th, and we could use some more help. Will you pitch in what you can? Click here to donate securely online. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=100]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Here’s the thing – if every single person reading this email donated just $1 , we’d be in fantastic shape for this month and beyond!
I love that for a couple of reasons – first, because it’s pretty amazing to me that so many of you read these emails and keep in touch with me and my campaign through this medium. I’m so grateful that you open and read these!
But even more than that, I love the reminder that small actions can add up to something really big.
One dollar may seem insignificant. After all, it’s hard to even find a good cup of coffee for that much! But at scale, those small donations really do add up – and they really do make a difference in what we’re able to accomplish. The money we’re able to raise now will determine the investments we can make in online voter outreach, the strength of our organizing on the ground, even the help we can offer other great Democratic candidates.
And the stakes are just so incredibly high. With the climate crisis wreaking havoc on communities across California and the country, extremist Republicans – like my opponent! – fighting tooth and nail to roll back our reproductive rights, and the epidemic of gun violence continuing to take unbearable tolls on American families, Democrats simply cannot afford not to win in November .
So I’m making a personal request right now: Can you pitch in any amount – whether that’s $1 or $100 – to help make sure we are prepared to give this year our all? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much.
-Sara

| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

As many of you all know, I have been an advocate for educational freedom since the 1990s. As a product of a district school, I have enjoyed informing other families about all their educational options. My entire family have attended K-12 public schools. We are so thankful for the various types of educational programs available in Arizona through our district, charter, micro schools, homeschool and private school options. Kids are not all built the same, and neither are our schools. It is truly the right time for parents to arm themselves with information to find the best fit for their own children.

As of late, it is becoming more and more common for [local school districts](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=916f4512f0&e=a7ab36849c) in District 2 like Deer Valley Unified School District (DVUSD) to look for “ways” to reject evaluating special needs students. This is not a new issue. In fact, it has been going on for years. DVUSD’s Superintendent Curtis Finch is not a fan of school choice. When I first ran for office in 2018, I met with him in 2019 and he spent part of our meet and greet blasting public charter schools knowing my own children had attended one. You can read the public district school superintendent’s blog [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=b1827542fe&e=a7ab36849c) from way back when he spent time as a district school superintendent blasting Arizona’s array of school choice options. In that same meet and greet, Finch bragged to me about how he fed news tips to local reporter Craig Harris. It’s no wonder subscription services have severely declined over the years at the local news rag.

Even when my own children attended a charter school for elementary school more than 17 years ago, the local school district didn’t want to administer a gifted test for either of my own children since they were not currently attending a district school. And yes, I was a taxpayer in Paradise Valley Unified School District, so they were required to manage the exam. My youngest kiddo ended up attending a district school from middle school through high school and was able to rely on that gifted test to be placed into two different gifted programs later.

On Tuesday, Hobbs vetoed another round of bills sent to her desk bringing her veto stamp to 52 bills vetoed so far, this legislative session. One of the bills she rejected includes trying to keep girls safe in a public-school bathroom shower and locker rooms from a biological male. I was an athlete in public school. I cannot imagine having to change in front of a biological male let alone shower in the same room. Our youth deserves better. Sadly, the Democratic governor doesn’t care about girl’s safety in these personal spaces since she vetoed the Arizona Women’s Bill of Rights the previous week.

The Attorney General decided to play politics with the Arizona Supreme Court’s abortion ruling. Mayes had her Solicitor General file a [motion](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4985a66ad2&e=a7ab36849c) for reconsideration with the court to try to score political points with her political base.

On Wednesday, the House met and [voted](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ef6b205677&e=a7ab36849c) to repeal the pre-Roe law. This bill was transmitted to the Senate for a vote next week.

On Thursday, a Yavapai County judge did not rule in favor of election integrity supporters in a [lawsuit](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=9dc5b516d6&e=a7ab36849c) dealing with early ballot signature verification and drop boxes. Judge Napper reversed his previous ruling from last fall when he agreed that the term ‘voter registration record’ requires that election officials only use the signature on file with the voter registration form for purposes of signature verification.

Also, on Thursday, the governor and the AG released a disturbing website called Reproductivehealth.az.gov to encourage Arizona females to seek out an abortion. Unfortunately, the leftwing governor and her AG sidekick think abortion is healthcare as does Biden and Kamala Harris.

I have toured a few crises pregnancy centers over the years, and they have terrific resources for expecting Moms. If you are looking for a local non-profit to support, please choose to donate time or funds to one of the crisis pregnancy centers in your area.

Prior to returning to the Arizona Legislature in July 2023, the governor removed two programs the former governor and Arizona legislature had brought together to help homeless pregnant women and provide resources to new pregnant Moms. Many offer educational classes and a support network for new Moms to thrive during pregnancy and after they give birth.

Sadly, the governor and AG are working in concert with the Biden Administration to push the "abortion is healthcare agenda" onto countless Arizonans. This is the only issue the Democrats are running on this election cycle. The border is wide open, and Biden’s inflationary economy is ruining businesses and households. When I meet and talk with voters, they are more worried about how their families will survive and be safe.

This coming week the Joint Legislative Budget Committee (JLBC) will meet on Wednesday, [May 1stin the morning](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3dc3adc2d7&e=a7ab36849c). Last week, they released [April 2024’s Monthly Fiscal Highlights](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=52731dd045&e=a7ab36849c). As you can see, this document helps breakdown the state of our economy by breaking down revenue forecasts and the state of our economy according to certain indices.

As we continue to wind down at the Capitol, my updates will continue to shorten. If you have a specific question that I can answer, please don’t hesitate to ask.

Take care,

| Peter, it’s been an exciting few months here at Bera HQ. Ami has been hard at work for Sacramento County in Congress. Read on to see what Ami’s been up to.
| | → **In Sacramento County, Ami had a roundtable discussion with HHS Secretary Xavier Becerra and San Juan Unified School District leadership on the importance of investing in the health care workforce.** This visit included a tour of the exceptional career technical education medical pathway and facility program at Rio Americano High School. As a doctor, Ami is a strong advocate for the expansion of the United States health care workforce.

**→ Ami is fighting back against Republican attempts to undermine the Affordable Care Act.** This landmark law has expanded affordable health care access for so many people in Sacramento County and around the country. As a doctor, Ami knows the importance of accessible, affordable health care and will defend the ACA.

**→ The Inflation Reduction Act, the landmark climate and public health law Ami supported, has kicked into gear as the Biden Administration announced the first 10 drugs selected for Medicare price negotiation.** The Inflation Reduction Act empowered Medicare to directly negotiate lower prescription drug prices to make healthcare affordable for seniors.

**→ Ami voted for bipartisan bills that were passed to provide funding and humanitarian relief for Ukraine.** The people of Ukraine are still fighting bravely against the unlawful invasion launched by Vladmir Putin. These bills provide vital resources necessary to help Ukrainians in their battle to defend their country.

**→ This month, Ami introduced a bipartisan resolution to commemorate the 45th anniversary of the Taiwan Relations Act following his trip to Taiwan in January as co-chair of the Congressional Taiwan Caucus.** He engaged with various leaders and officials following the success of Taiwan's democratic elections. His visit and the resolution both aimed to continue the development of a decades-long economic and defense relationship between the two countries.

**→ As a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, Ami traveled to Seoul and met with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul following the Third Summit for Democracy in Seoul.** Through his work as a member of Congress, Ami is dedicated to developing further ties economically, in areas of trade, and culturally, in addition to security and technology, between the United States and South Korea.

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**April 28, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
As we approach the conclusion of the 2024 legislative session here in Colorado, it's imperative to take stock of the flurry of activity happening under the gold dome. With just over two weeks remaining until the gavel falls on May 8th, lawmakers find themselves grappling with a staggering workload, navigating through a maze of bills that could significantly impact our state's future.
At this juncture, [374 bills out of the 673 introduced still require decisive action](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This session has witnessed the introduction of the fifth-highest number of bills in the past 25 years, a testament to the breadth and complexity of issues under consideration. The House, taking the lead on appropriations, has introduced 462 bills, while the Senate has introduced 211, reflecting the multifaceted nature of legislative priorities.
One particularly contentious issue looming large is the debate over [property tax reform](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). A bipartisan state commission has been laboring to overhaul the tax code, but significant divisions remain. Democrats' proposals have faced criticism for their potential to burden taxpayers and local governments, highlighting the need for thoughtful, conservative alternatives.
In this final stretch, the legislature must prioritize measures that foster economic growth, preserve individual freedoms, and [uphold fiscal responsibility](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). With the state constitution restricting the number of referred measures to the ballot, every decision made carries profound implications for Colorado's future.
As we witness the legislative process unfold in these closing days, it is incumbent upon lawmakers to heed the voices of their constituents and enact policies that reflect our shared conservative values. Let us hope that they rise to the occasion, delivering results that safeguard our prosperity and uphold the principles upon which our great state was founded.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **STATE**
---
**[Topping the 4th District special election ballot will be an Approval Voting Party candidate. But why?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Candidates from the two major parties appearing at the bottom of the 4th Congressional District's special election ballot will have to hope voters read the whole ballot.
[Democrats advance first-in-the-nation gun bill, one mandating gun owners to purchase insurance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The punishment Democrats will assess on Coloradans wishing to pursue their Constitutional right of gun ownership will be either the costs of an insurance policy or fines beginning at $500 for a first offense of not having firearm liability insurance, if House Bill 1270 passes.
[Independents breaking for GOP's Evans by 6 points in toss-up Colorado House district, polling says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Independent voters in Colorado's 8th Congressional District are leaning toward a Republican challenger to incumbent Rep. Yadira Caraveo (D-CO), according to a GOP polling memo showing the freshman lawmaker in a vulnerable position in one of the most competitive races of the 2024 cycle.
[What words can't Colorado Republicans say in immigration debate? House Democratic leaders gave them list.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado Republicans are accusing Democratic leaders of censorship, saying the latter have provided them with a list of words they are prohibited from using during floor debates.
|
---
**NATIONAL**
[Davis: Strong voter ID laws confirm not just who you are but where you live](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The debate over voter ID typically centers on the need to prove _we are who we say we are_ when we vote, which is obviously very important. But voter ID can and should also be used to prove _we live where we say we live_.

[Markos: Opposition to Trump is rooted in contempt for ordinary voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A complaint I hear increasingly leveled at contemporary American politicians is that they are out of touch with voters, if not downright contemptuous of them.
[Supreme Court could pave the way for homeless camp bans in hearing of anti-camping complaint](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) As the nation's homelessness crisis deepens, the Supreme Court on Monday will weigh a case that has captured the attention of state officials with some of the largest homeless populations.
|
---
**LOCAL**
[Dairy herd in Northeast Colorado tests positive for Bird Flu, USDA lab reports](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [CBS COLORADO, EASTERN PLAINS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado is now one of nine states in which dairy cattle have tested positive for avian influenza. A U.S. Department of Agriculture laboratory confirmed Thursday the detection of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N1 from dairy cows in a northeastern Colorado herd. It is the first detection of the disease in Colorado.
[Denver shares "Newcomer Playbook," offering advice on handling immigration crisis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [DENVER GAZETTE, DENVER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Even as Denver cuts its budget and diverts funds in order to pay for its response to the immigration crisis that some say is self-inflicted, Mayor Mike Johnston's administration released a "playbook" that contains the "best practices and procedures for cities to welcome newcomers arriving from the U.S. southern border."

[Pro-Palestinian protesters occupy Auraria campus in Denver, demand divestment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [DENVER GAZETTE, DENVER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) More than 200 hundred protesters -- many of them students -- occupied the Auraria campus on Thursday night to make several demands, notably divestment from corporations that operate in Israel.

[One introduced wolf is dead in Colorado as another is likely expecting pups in Grand County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [THE COLORADO SUN, WESTERN SLOPE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Just a few hours after U.S. Fish and Wildlife biologists confirmed that one of the 10 gray wolves transplanted to Colorado in December was found dead in Larimer County, the state's top wildlife official told ranchers he will not kill a wolf blamed for the death of four cows in Grand County because it is likely the mate to a wolf that appears to be denning.
|
---

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: The battle for free speech is going to the Supreme Court
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsibewOiNr

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osibewOiNr

One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court, and you probably haven't heard about it.

Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills that prohibit viewpoint discrimination on social media. These bills were passed for a reason - conservative voices are being suppressed. Disfavored opinions
(and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that's not an exaggeration; we've experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we
told a joke that referred to a male person ("Admiral" Rachel Levine) as a man.

It's gotten completely out of hand.

Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media
companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values.

That's why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws.

Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee

This is nothing new for us. We've long been committed to defending free speech in the public square. Here are some of the free speech battles we've taken on over the years:

We filed an amicus brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in support of a humorist who was actually jailed because of a parody Facebook page.
We sued the Attorney General's Office in the state of California to block the enforcement of a law requiring social media companies to regularly report "misinformation, disinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech."
We sued the New York Attorney General too, for the same censorship debauchery.
We refused to delete a tweet that resulted in the suspension of our Twitter account with over 1 million followers
We told Mark Zuckerberg he sucks

Fighting on the front lines for free speech in the public square isn't easy or inexpensive, but it's the right thing to do. And it's making a difference. But we can't do it without you.

clean_body: One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court, and you probably haven't heard about it. Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills that prohibit viewpoint discrimination on social media. These bills were passed for a reason - conservative voices are being suppressed. Disfavored opinions (and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that's not an exaggeration; we've experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we told a joke that referred to a male person ("Admiral" Rachel Levine) as a man. It's gotten completely out of hand. Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values. That's why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws. Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee This is nothing new for us. We've long been committed to defending free speech in the public square. Here are some of the free speech battles we've taken on over the years: We filed an amicus brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in support of a humorist who was actually jailed because of a parody Facebook page. We sued the Attorney General's Office in the state of California to block the enforcement of a law requiring social media companies to regularly report "misinformation, disinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech." We sued the New York Attorney General too, for the same censorship debauchery. We refused to delete a tweet that resulted in the suspension of our Twitter account with over 1 million followers We told Mark Zuckerberg he sucks Fighting on the front lines for free speech in the public square isn't easy or inexpensive, but it's the right thing to do. And it's making a difference. But we can't do it without you. Will you become a paid subscriber to The Babylon Bee to help us stay in the fight? name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: Back the Blue
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vslE2vOi9N

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oslE2vOi9N

,

I am so grateful for our police officers.

As an American who believes in law and order, truth, and justice, I have always stood with the public servants who protect our communities.

Please join me in thanking uniformed men and women by signing our 'Back the Blue Petition' and letting brave officers know that we are grateful for their service and sacrifice.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began propelling criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to "defund the police."

I refuse to accept that we must cater to the bottom denominator of our society and that the black community must fight and scream and demand support for the people in our community who are up to no good.

That's one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT - an organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of community service.

Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers, while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve our communities.

To join these chapters and stand with police officers, please sign the national petition today.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

This summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving back to the Baltimore Police Department and learned some history about the city's police force.

The first state chapter - BLEXIT North Carolina - paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT's appreciation.

If you 'Back the Blue' - and believe that we must support local heroes - please sign the national petition right away.

While the 'defund the police' crowd wants us to think minorities stand with them - polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase.

We've been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals - those lies have been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day.

We must stop the deception that is harming urban communities and demeaning police around the nation.

If you are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the way forward.

Join me in letting our police officers know that you support law and order, justice, and their valiant efforts to keep our communities safe.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Candace Owens
Chair of BLEXIT

## Tornadoes Strike Midwest
Tornadoes ripped [through the Midwest](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO2zAQRL9G6lagVkvRLlikcee0KYW1uLQYU6JAMpbz94c7X3nlDAaDh_fnOl05xLDdf_Mqtvo08VzDUyYCPAPSRK2zXgRlaMX2pqfhTMpQu1jyxig0g8ye_YkQtb5h742f3YlGjW2wqJAU4Vmd9DjojkbjvHimmyaN_dCQEhdqyt3fFLa6iI__01NyN6e1jXapdS_N8KvBS4OX4zg6n16HcF3ek8_ynWCTozR4qSlv7BKkf_WWhR8gr13mKg72yGErUOXFBdIj8pJWhgdvhQvwnkMENFDkKVng-7XN1u1HiDGU0TSk7iuH-MVWfzT1EQAA__919W23) this weekend, killing four people and injuring more in Oklahoma. Twisters also touched down in [Nebraska, Iowa, and Texas](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2v4yAQAH-N3RHBevFH4eKadLn2SmuBJdkLNhFwse7fP-XVrxxNM5o_t-1GkuS4_6ad1xbzRr7JmzdUsCjADfuwRmbgoefVTAaHBfWE_WNlP1ogz2acUM-j0y46i2AXPw-WDPWyggbUCIue7TjYC45TiBwJnUULZuhQc5CWy-VvlqM9OKb_-c3l4vPep_XR2qt2w68Orh1c6XXwWT_qA6WJT9zBteVyUMhql3BybepgV6g-SUk-Se1Sa_5XRD3pqFRVNDBNmiwEMyKGefYmMBm3gPPLooe-rOF1SkpSx6lDfd9J0ndO-3HOVwAAAP___BllQg), leaving a path of injuries, destroyed buildings, and a death in Iowa. Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt spoke at a press conference in the hard-hit town of Sulphur, describing the scene as "...d _efinitely the most damage since I've been governor that I've seen_." [See video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jweGB7YOjiLV07WgQ_YhoMESax-vdVOnc-nU66r8tycTHFfPt0O9kWyuJ8iy9akMPEARfsVhuIgFRHVg4S1YRiwG6zBsLk1XU0KEdNAg05ba5SqsETSj110YIAFAiTGLVRukczrIGCw6tGDVIxFLTGVmr_XWJuG4X0U15Ue1_2LtmttcfB1AeDmcF8nmd_L768IYPZ1RZ9Igbz8UyP7Vl5uSe3ld3xVmp2a-Gr292NeKbz4L7kQJWyfxtGGBjNILtq18cZU4qHGRiK2-5i-ou3f1f8BgAA__-6gl-d). ## CNN Poll: Trump Presidency a Success
New polling [data from CNN](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9u9CAQBPCnwR0nvKz_FRRf4-6-NqW1mOVuIwyWTe6Ut4-cOs1Uo99I83Ff7iRJ8uM_bexqLAutVV68oIZJAy7YBBeZgW3Drh1atBOaAZunG0Mc_TpZnlZjezatH_zUwWB7D-QDNOLAABqEyYxdb7sb9kOIHAl9hx20VqHhILUct88iuT45pu_y4uO2lq1J7lnrfir7T8GsYN5LkiorpbccfDUUzJevYDZXwKhgrsfXtuuNJFeSfOpMVUqmpBNT0JetvQTOCubmcGF_S0py9oNC89hI0u9y_fOHnwAAAP__hntd9Q) shows a six percent national advantage for former President Trump in the presidential race. The most notable polling result, however, may be that 55% of respondents say that Trump's presidency was a success. It's a significant flip from the results of the same question after January 6th, 2021, when 55% said that the administration was a failure. In the recent poll, 61% said that President Biden's first term has been a failure.
## NFL Commish Teases Changes
NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell [gave an interview](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1yszAQAJ9GdMeIQ_wVKr6Gzl-bkjmsAysjdIykmPjtM06dZqstdvbjttzIBx_3_3SwLZssdC_-yYsBnADNYipnN2bktmLbDI1pJ6MHUz1sOxocecW-70fHw6TdqHXnsGtID9xQ5S1qNNrgpMeub7va9IPbeCOzdqbDplVGs_NFUv0pPpYHb-ElT071XY4q2EcpZ1btP4Wzwvm6rvq-5nxKKvltKJzjFt7kKyuck-ycYBdxHALwizMc8vRxh_x1coJVrgCOCkMzwk4HQ2bKEsHHwilS8RIpAH-fFLOXCBQdHJJY4Vwl687Lh-BzPyij94N8-M0sf077CQAA__9hVXBI) over the weekend and forecasted some scheduling changes for America's most popular sport. Fans have been pushing for years for a post-Superbowl national holiday, and they may inadvertently get it if Goodell's plan comes to fruition: expand the NFL regular season to 18 games and move the SB to the day before President's Day. clean_body: Tornadoes ripped this weekend, killing four people and injuring more in Oklahoma. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: really big announcement for you only 📎
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I know it’s a Sunday evening, and I’m really sorry for interrupting it!

_I’m sure you weren’t planning on reading a highly important email from me or anyone else today._

But this may be one of the most important emails I’m sending all year – and it’s for your eyes only.

**Pro-Life Friend, I’m only sending this email today to you and a small, select group of supporters I know I can count on for two reasons . . .**

First, I need the election year plans I’ve included with this email to remain confidential.

_So, please don’t forward them on to anyone_! _I’m really trusting you not to!_

Second, this email doesn’t apply to everyone. It only applies to you and a small group of our very most important supporters _(as I’ll explain)_.

_You see, two very generous _Students for Life Action_ donors – one from Texas and one from Florida – just agreed to a whopping $200,000 Matching Challenge in support of our 2024 election year Battleplan_!

This is great news. I know our supporters are going to be excited about this big announcement!

**But I’m telling you first because the donors who made this commitment asked me to reach out to you _first_ because they offered to double-match every dollar you give to this “early announcement” email!**

**[That means they’ve agreed to give $2 for every dollar you decide to give](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-y/)!**

They asked me to do this because they know we have a really important core group of supporters who _care deeply_ , _give sacrificially_ , _and are commited to fighting no matter what_.

And they asked me to extend this offer for you as a way of letting you know so many people appreciate all you do.

**[If you could give $1,000, it would be worth $3,000](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-j/)!**

**[If you could give $500, it would be worth $1,500](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-i/)!**

**[If you could give $250, it would be worth $750](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-d/)!**

**[If you could give $100, it would be worth $300](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-h/)!**

**[If you could give $50, it would be worth $150](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-k/)!**

Pro-Life Friend, I’ve never been able to offer any of our supporters anything like this, so there really has never been a better time to give.

_It’s also never been more important._

As _The Washington Post_ reported not long ago, President Joe Biden’s re-election campaign “plans to spend every day until November 5” talking about abortion.

And if the President manages to stumble to re-election – and the Abortion Lobby seizes control of the U.S. House and expands their U.S. Senate majority – there could be no stopping their radical agenda, including:

*****_PACKING THE U.S. SUPREME COURT_** with as many as five new justices who will serve as rubber stamps for Planned Parenthood’s radical and bloody agenda. The constant attacks on Justice Clarence Thomas we’ve seen over the past year were designed to grease the skids for this;

*****_DESTROYING THE U.S. SENATE FILIBUSTER_ ,** which is a Senate rule that effectively requires all major legislation to gain 60 Senate votes for passage. Pro-abortion Democrats are currently only two votes away from gutting the filibuster, which will allow them to pass any pro-abortion law they want and change America forever; and

*****_RAMMING PRO-ABORTION LEGISLATION FAR WORSE THAN _ROE V. WADE_ INTO LAW_.** President Biden is on record supporting the so-called _“Women’s Health Protection Act.”_ The Abortion Lobby’s goal is to pass this federal legislation forcing all 50 states to allow abortion-on-demand up until (and even up to a week after) birth – and force taxpayers to fund it all!
**[Given the very real threat we’re facing, I hope you will take this opportunity to have your contribution double-matched](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-u/).**

As I mentioned, this offer isn’t for everyone and it won’t last.

So, I hope you’ll take advantage.

The good news is, polls say President Biden is continuing to stumble with young voters.

While polling has been untrustworthy at best for years now, media elites are starting to freak out, issuing a constant flood of headlines like:

*** “Biden, a Pre-Boomer, is Losing the Young Voters Democrats Need” (CNN);

*** “Trump Gets Surprise Boost With Young Voters Amid Biden Disillusionment” _(The Hill);_ and

*** “Democrats Have a Problem With Young Voters. They Hope the Battle Over Abortion Will Solve It. Will That Work?” _(Los Angeles Times)._
All of this is no accident.

With your support, we’ve conducted one of the largest youth outreach efforts in American history over the past year.

We’ve visited 947 college campuses across the country, trained 28,252 activists, started 163 new campus chapters _(bringing our total to 1,447),_ and garnered over 231,400,000 views of our online videos.

**With our years of experience of talking about abortion with young voters, no one is better at talking to young people about abortion than we are.**

In fact, we converted a whopping 19% of the pro-abortion/on-the-fence young people we talked to last year.

We’ve become so successful that during last year’s ballot referendum battle in Ohio, _Students for Life Action_ found we could convert a pro-abortion young voter into a pro-life voter for only $12.

The problem is just that we didn’t have the money to compete with the Abortion Lobby and fully fund our programs _(as has been the case in several referendum battles so far)._

And if history repeats itself again in 2024, we could be staring straight at nothing short of a disaster.

**[That’s why this $200,000 Matching Challenge is so critical – and why I hope you’ll take the opportunity to have your financial support double-matched](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-o/).**

Your generosity will make a tremendous impact, especially since _Students for Life Action_ specializes in reaching voters aged 18-34 – a demographic virtually no one else on the political “Right” even bothers to talk to.

As the largest voting demographic in the country, even surpassing Baby Boomers, these are the very voters President Biden is counting on for his re-election.

_That’s why Vice President Kamala Harris has been crisscrossing college campuses in Presidential Battleground States since late last fall, believing abortion will be the Biden campaign’s silver bullet in 2024_.

With your help, _Students for Life Action_ is standing in their way.

And we’ve proven very successful in the past as our election-year successes were not brought about by accident, but by hard work, data crunching, and careful targeting.

For example, in North Carolina’s 2022 U.S. Senate race, we targeted youth voters who were expected to turn out at a rate of 33%-50% during that election.

We knew these voters would vote pro-life at an 80% rate . . . if we managed to get them to the polls . . . so we threw the kitchen sink at them reaching them 8 to 10 times each with targeted digital ads.

Because of that effort, 75% of these young, pro-life voters turned out!

All in all, we secured pledges from 42,000 young people to “VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST.”

_And on Election Day, pro-life Republican Ted Budd narrowly defeated pro-abortion, Democrat radical Cheri Beasley by 3.2% of the vote, gaining us one more solid pro-lifer in the U.S. Senate_.

There’s no doubt that _Students for Life Action’s_ programs work.

But with everything on the line in 2024, we have to be prepared to do more than ever.

We have the planning down pat.

Here is the link to our full _**2024 Battleplan**_ for your review.

https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/2024battleplan.pdf

Once again, I’m urging you to please keep this confidential.

I’m not sending this to all of our supporters.

**_But I am sending this to you because I know you understand each and every one of us have a duty to our country – and our beliefs – to give 2024 everything we’ve got_.**

Or else evil will triumph.

Pro-abortion radicals and their pals in the media want us to give up because they know we can beat them.

The two generous donors who enabled this Matching Challenge told me to make sure I offer this double-match opportunity to the “fighters” I have among our supporters . . .

. . . The people who never give up when it comes to fighting for what’s right.

I think you belong on that list, Pro-Life Friend.

I hope after you’re finished reviewing our 2024 Battleplan _(I’ve included the link again in the P.S.),_**[you’ll give generously in support of this $200,000 Matching Challenge](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-b/).**

**[If you give $1,000, it will be worth $3,000](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-n/)!**

**[If you give $500, it will be worth $1,500](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-p/)!**

**[If you give $250, it will be worth $750](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-x/)!**

**[If you give $100, it will be worth $300](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-m/)!**

**[If you give $50, it will be worth $150](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-c/)!**

Just please give what you can – whatever that is – and every dollar will be double-matched.

**[Even if you can give $10 or $25, every dollar matters](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltlrky-duchtdja-q/).**

And thank you so much for all you do!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – Once again, here is the confidential link to our 2024 Battleplan.

https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/2024battleplan.pdf

Please do not forward. We will be removing the plan once we’re confident you’ve had a chance to read it.

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

body:
I just experienced a vile, dishonest, personal attack that demonstrates everything wrong with politics today.
| | | |
---

---
Hello Peter,
The Lies Must Stop!
I just experienced a vile, dishonest, personal attack that demonstrates everything wrong with politics today. I expect this from Dina Titus, but it is disappointing that any Republican would use this tactic.
A couple of days ago, a supporter received an unsolicited email from an anonymous source with a link to a slanderous, lie-filled article about me. Instead of debating the issues and letting the voters decide, this opponent paid a political "assassin" to "kill" my campaign.
We cannot allow this to stand.
Anyone who campaigns this way will only add to the rotten swamp in Washington and cannot be trusted. Whoever financed this disgusting political attack should withdraw immediately.
This article had so many outlandish lies that it would be laughable if the stakes for our country weren't so high. Here is a sample of his disgraceful lies:
Lie #1: "Mark Robertson and his wife Lisa filed for Chapter 13 bankruptcy in May 2005" Truth: I've never filed for bankruptcy. My wife's name is Lesly.
Lie #2: "Robertson owed $1,308.07 in child support from a previous marriage" Truth: I've only been married once - to Lesly for more than 41 years (and counting).

**[California Weighs Law Requiring Speed Limiters On All New Vehicles](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-OFUgqA9q2ChzHVKQ)**

# ONE OF US - FIGHTING FOR US!
---

|

| My Friends,
Friends,
I am very happy to report that after our hard work at the Maine GOP Convention we have picked up three new endorsements! It is my absolute pleasure to announce that Representatives Irene Giffords, Abby Griffin and Caleb Ness have endorsed our campaign for Congress!
Rep. Irene Giffords of Lincoln does a wonderful job on the Marine Resources Committee in Augusta. She is committed to protecting our heritage industries on the coast and always a presence in our Republican caucus. We thank her for endorsement and steady work in committee.
Rep. Abigail Griffin of Levant has a heavy workload in the Health and Human Services Committee. As a retired teacher she always puts our kid's health and welfare first. She knows how vital parents' rights are and she fights for them. We thank her for her hard work and her endorsement.
Rep. Caleb Ness of Fryeburg serves on the Innovation and Business Committee where he works to fight burdensome regulations and to make life for our business community easier. He does a great job and has given several great floor speeches defending the Constitution. Caleb comes from a family deeply rooted in their faith and we could not be prouder to have his endorsement.
These wonderful individuals add to the long list of Maine House Republicans who have endorsed our campaign. These people have worked closely with both my opponent and I over the last two years.
Having the majority of those endorsing anyone choose to support our campaign for Congress says something!
Thank you to everyone who has endorsed Team Soboleski!
Stay safe, Mike

# THREE DAYS: In-Person Voting Begins Thursday - Dan Cox Stands for America First As the Common Sense Voice for Freedom.
Dear ,

Thanks to you, last week we met a short-term financial goal and purchased radio ads. However, we are only 50% there for all radio ads we are buying.

And in just three days, potentially over 30% of the GOP likely voters in the Sixth District will begin to Early Vote.

**I need to[raise $2500 TODAY](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=50ce864dbb&e=5bb5efcda7) to purchase a week of necessary radio ads.**

The Washington Post just reported on my performance at two of our three Primary GOP debates **_where it noted I was the sole candidate who unhesitatingly stood for America First with President Trump, who called out the truth of the 2020 stolen election from Trump, and who opposes recklessly getting us involved in a potential WWIII conflict by funding now over $171 BILLION taxpayer dollars to Ukraine for war_**.

[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=58508baf5a&e=5bb5efcda7)

I am Reverend Darrius Butler, who is running for Georgia's 8th Congressional District with a bold vision for a brighter future.
In these challenging times, we need leaders who are not just willing to stand up for what's right, but who are committed to turning those convictions into actions. I believe I am that leader. Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.

In the news

body:

---
Peter,

I wanted you to be the first to hear the big news: **I’m launching my campaign for Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District.**

[_I’d like to tell you my story, and ask you to chip in to my campaign for a better future for Wisconsin and our country._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83925455/469951419/1420786780?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240429_1_1&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjllMTcwM2MxLTIwMDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Uh_J-R2PEfR0etC4rFt4kiWglaXFyNZ-exEQFcQ4oCE=)

I grew up in northeast Wisconsin, in a working class family where too often, **we struggled.**

As a kid, I would never have dreamed of running for office – though I always wanted to serve my community. I’ve been practicing medicine for years, **focusing on women’s health and reproductive care, while working particularly in underserved communities.**

But today, I’m not practicing in the Green Bay area, where I grew up and where I live. **Thanks first to the harsh restrictions on abortion care in Wisconsin that were passed in 1849 – before women could even vote – and then to the threat of retaliation from Republicans after I helped overturn those restrictions** I travel to Minnesota every month, and also travel to Arizona to continue to care for patients who need it most.

Those long commutes have given me plenty of time to think about where we’re at as a state, and as a country. I’ve spent a lot of time talking with my neighbors, fellow doctors, and folks all across our community about the challenges we’re facing. **Our healthcare system is in crisis. Doctors and nurses are leaving the field in droves. There’s confusion about how we can care for our patients under new restrictions that are a direct result of _Dobbs_.** And it all goes back to the division that too many politicians have sown in recent years.

**I’m running for office to do something about it.**

We have a real opportunity to flip this open seat, put an end to the divisiveness, and pass policies that help families in northeast Wisconsin – and every corner of the country. From expanding rural broadband access to implementing a social safety net that catches struggling families, we’ve got a lot of work to do. It won’t be easy. But most things worth doing aren’t easy.

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Your America is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c33694%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DSHPixiJ3mPlnDvgUmueQw&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c33605%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nVBHtr6NopkI0Htch8k%2bMg&sysid=1) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c33606%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UKF0I7%2fiWVVoP2V14ADh4A&sysid=1)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c33607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uPzx%2bcAuMRUZrC5ClcYVEw&sysid=1)**

What Rick Scott did after Florida banned abortion
| | |
---
Listen, nothing like this has happened so far in our battleground race: **My opponent, Rick Scott, just dropped MILLIONS on attack ads after the Florida Supreme Court green-lit a six-week abortion ban.**
We know Rick Scott — who spent $64 million of his own fortune to buy this seat last time around — can fund attack ads at the drop of a hat.

But his _rushing_ to go up on the air after Florida's abortion ban isn't a sign of strength. In fact, it's the opposite.

**Rick Scott is scared. He is weak. And he will once again do anything and spend _everything_ to keep Florida red.**
But, friend, ours is the grassroots movement that will defeat him: **Polling shows our team in the lead, and experts at _The New York Times_ just named Florida as one of the most likely Senate seats to flip blue.**

So when Rick Scott goes on the air with ads _lying_ about his record on abortion and _lying_ about me in a desperate effort to save his campaign — just as the momentum is on OUR side — what must we do? **Fight back. Because to Rick Scott we say:_Y_** _**a no**_ _**más.** _**Enough is enough**

Rick Scott knows that he can't win this race by telling the truth about his record. He built his fortune as the CEO of a hospital chain that pled guilty to what the Justice Department called the largest Medicare fraud scheme ever. He made off with millions and faced zero consequences. Now, he's pushing a far-right agenda that would ban abortions nationwide, raise taxes on working families, and end vital programs like Social Security and Medicare.
My story is different. As a teen immigrant from Ecuador, I fought hard to create my own American Dream. In high school, I worked early morning shifts to help my family afford rent for our one room apartment.
I studied hard to earn a scholarship that made college possible for me and dedicated my career to public service. Eventually, I ran for Congress, flipped a battleground district blue, and became the first South American immigrant elected to the House. In Congress, I fought tirelessly to expand Medicare access, lower the cost of living, end gun violence, and protect families like yours.
**I've spent my life****fighting to protect the opportunities that made my story possible****and giving back to the communities that gave me so much. Rick Scott has spent his career getting rich and leaving working families behind. That's why I'm running for Senate to defeat him — because Floridians will suffer if he wins six more years.**

subject: 🏁 Final Republican Push 🇺🇸
body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f5fca2d4ac&e=0a12281e0e)
# Your support today is crucial. 🚨
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f01cc67fe9&e=0a12281e0e)
With only 17 days remaining until the pivotal May 14th Maryland primary, your support is absolutely crucial now more than ever. Our campaign is surging forward, engaging voters throughout the district through various channels.
This week alone, we've reached out to 15,000 households with a targeted mailer, 3,000 additional households with 3,000 postcards mailed, placed commercials in Warehouse Cinemas in Frederick and Hagerstown, and broadcasted radio ads across five stations in Western Maryland.
But we're not stopping there—every day until May 14th, I'm actively pursuing opportunities to speak directly to voters on as many radio stations as possible. You can catch a recent candidate statement I made with Montgomery County Media (MCM), which they are currently airing on their networks. 🎥
We're leaving no stone unturned in our quest to secure the Republican nomination on May 14th, and your support is what will propel us to victory.
Click the link below to watch the video! ⬇️
[CLICK HERE TO VIEW VIDEO](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=cf4556f617&e=0a12281e0e)
# GOTV Efforts & Fundraising
Voting has already begun for the Maryland Primary. Absentee ballots started being mailed by the state of Maryland at the beginning of April. I am proud to say that out of the 16,500 Republican Absentee Voters in MD-06, we have reached almost 90% of these voters via text messages, mailers, and postcards. This is important because, during our 2022 race, we did not have the resources then to reach absentee voters. I am confident that these numbers will show in our favor on May 14th!
The next critical round of voters we need to reach is for Early Voting (May 2nd-9th) & Day of Voting (May 14th). Out of the remaining Republican non-Absentee voters that voted in the 2022 primary (around 44,000 voters) we have also reached about 90% of these voters via door-knocking, mailers, postcards, & text messages. These numbers don’t even include the Facebook Ads, Digital Advertising, Radio, & Movie Theater voters we are reaching. So imagine how much higher our reach actually is!
The purpose of outlining the above numbers is because I want you all to know EXACTLY where your support and contributions have been and are going to be.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. Here is what our campaign needs help within the next 17 days to get over the finish line:
1. **Postcard Mailing:** $1,800 (Last 3,000 postcards being mailed out)
2. **Texting:** $3,000 (Last two texts, one on May 1st before early voting starts & one on May 13th the ay before Election Day)
3. **Digital Advertising:** $3,700 (For dates April 29-May 14th)

I know that many of you have already helped our campaign out so much, and many of you have not been able to contribute monetarily due the the economically challenging times we are all facing. I truly believe the future of our district and country is at stake, and I KNOW we can win this nomination with your help through this last push. I have skin in the game as I have also contributed some of my personal funds for this effort. And I really hate to ask you for monetary help, but I need your help now more than ever.
Please consider donating today and helping us fundraise the $8,500 mentioned above by Monday, April 29th to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution TODAY:
[**https://secure.winred.com/roca-for-congress/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=bdaf7518e2&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a693e4b4ab&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d9984f85f2&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=1fcd114c94&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b4e1523d09&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f68c599ad4&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e39b961471&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=8be5ec4e56&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=74a678b841&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f93b979e18&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2fde5d8e99&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=16fb31cba1&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a2b689a46f&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f42ba22812&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6a6afd7da0&e=0a12281e0e)

Dear Peter,
We have fantastic news to share . . .
Thanks to your unwavering support, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. _has successfully secured his spot on the ballot in the critical swing state of Michigan_! This victory is not just a win for our campaign but a testament to the power of a united, grassroots movement dedicated to restoring integrity and healing America. And it is sending shockwaves throughout the political establishment - _it wasn’t supposed to happen!_
However, our mission extends beyond Michigan. Team Kennedy still needs your help NOW to reach our ultimate goal — achieving ballot access in all 50 states.

name: Ben Wikler, Chair of WisDems
subject: Fair maps are here. Wisconsin’s gerrymandering nightmare is over!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9dd67f54-8cd9-4cd0-99b7-2b2e9053b59c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
| | |
---
| | | Hi, Peter. The long, dark night of ultra-partisan gerrymandering is over, and a new day for democracy now dawns in the Badger State. Recently, a new set of state legislative maps were signed into law for Wisconsin. These maps are graded “A” for fairness by the head of the nonpartisan Princeton Gerrymandering Project. The current maps scored an F. With the stroke of a pen, Wisconsin went from a “democracy desert” to, well, a democracy. This was all possible because of you. [I’m going to ask you to split a $10 donation between the Democratic Party of Wisconsin and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3d1dda1d-8aef-4cbb-be8b-4bbc2594e709/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), but I want to tell you how we got here: Wisconsin’s gerrymandering crisis began in 2011, when Republican lawmakers drew legislative lines that guaranteed even landslide election losses wouldn’t cost them their majorities. The result was one of the most egregious, extreme partisan gerrymanders in American political history. In 2012 and 2018, Wisconsin voters overwhelmingly voted for Democratic majorities in the legislature but Republicans won huge majorities of the seats. In 2020 and 2022, Democrats won major statewide victories, but Republicans won near-supermajorities. All the while, Republican politicians in Wisconsin have used their power to restrict access to the ballot, remove authorities that voters had entrusted to statewide elected officials like the Governor and Attorney General, and smash the freedoms of workers to organize and advocate for themselves. For thirteen years, the democracy-proof legislature has been laying siege to democracy itself. But those statewide victories added up. In 2018, 2020, and 2023, voters built a new progressive majority on the State Supreme Court. By electing Governor Evers and preventing GOP supermajorities, they stopped hard-right maps from being signed into law. And last year, a civic uprising prevented Republicans from impeaching Janet Protasiewicz. In December, the Supreme Court ruled that Wisconsin’s legislative maps were unconstitutional. This wasn’t easy. This team had to knock on doors, call phones, chip in, share our views with friends and online—year after year, election after election, never giving up even when it felt like all was lost. But we did it. Today, the work doesn’t end. The candidate recruitment process now goes into overdrive. And at the same time, we remain vigilant in case Republican politicians in Madison and their allies once again, through the courts or any other strategy, attempt to thwart majority rule. Today, we commit to doing the work, ending the malign speakership of Robin Vos, breaking the GOP supermajority in the State Senate, and paving the way towards a Democratic state Senate majority in 2026. I’d be remiss if I didn’t ask. The number of competitive legislative seats will triple so we’ll need triple the support, Peter. [Can you chip in a $10 split donation between WisDems and Blue Amp Action to help us organize voters in every corner of Wisconsin where Democrats have the chance to win?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T52a19c2a-3b5e-4e5b-990c-b95ed956dd23/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

---
|
Are you aware there is a statewide team of volunteers working to ensure our elections are fair & accurate, conforming to all current state & federal laws?

The Ohio Election Integrity Network, or OEIN, has teams working on:

• Voter roll maintenance
• Data & technology (including machines)
• Legislation (proposed & in-effect)
• Mail-in & absentee voting
• Media & promotion
• Stopping ranked choice voting in Ohio
• Recruiting poll workers & poll observers
• The "Citizens Research Project"
• Vulnerable voters

**THE OHIO PRECINCT STRATEGY
UNDERSTAND IT!
EMBRACE IT!
BECOME PART OF IT!**

---
|
If you haven't heard of the "Precinct Strategy" it is imperative you learn what it is and how it can be a big part of taking back our country, state, and communities from corrupt political insiders.

Ohio's political parties have an organization, codified in the Ohio Revised Code (ORC), that provides for 88 county parties and 1 state party for each of the 2 major political parties (Republican & Democrat).

Every precinct (or in some counties every ward & township) has an elected, unpaid, representative on their County Central Committee (CCC). These are the lowest-level elected offices in America, and a great way for average Americans to have an impact on how we are governed. All politics truly is local, right down to the precinct level. **And the time commitment is typically no more than a few hours a calendar quarter.**

The Ohio Precinct Strategy was formed to help Ohioans understand Ohio's political structure and identify grassroots candidates to run for these seats. The only qualification you need is to be an Ohio registered voter.

May 2026, about 2 years from now, is when more than half of Ohio's counties will have central committee elections.

If you have even a single spark of interest (or know someone else who might) please go to (or have them go to):

[https://www.ohioprecinctstrategy.org](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=557faff262&e=5c740fa3e2)

Or, click on the image below!

There, you (or they) can register, find more information on filing to run, how to run and win, and what you can do once in office. We also have people across the state who can provide any help & information you might need.

If you have any questions, feel free to call or text Mark Pukita at 614-499-0599 (c) and have a chat. You can email him too: [mark@mark4ohio.com](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=0aed81e84d&e=5c740fa3e2)

FIX OUR PUBLIC SCHOOLS!
BECOME A BOARD MEMBER!
HERE'S HOW!**

---

**This section is a repeat from last week's message because we had such great success from getting the word out! 10 people stepped up to explore running for school boards in Ohio just last week! Can we make it 20 more this week?**

Next year, in November of 2025, all public school districts in Ohio will have at least 2 school board seats up for re-election, or if there is no incumbent for the seat, up for election.

We need concerned citizens who are for parental rights, a return to the basics of education, and completely depoliticizing Ohio's public schools, to run for these school board seats.

Anyone can run & there is no need for any kind of special qualifications, experience, or skills. All that's needed is a desire & common sense.

And, the Ohio School Board Constitutional Coalition (OSBCC) can help you every step of the way. 40% of the candidates they helped last election won!

The volunteers at OSBCC will get back to you to get you started off strong. It's not too early to start your campaign!

That’s why we’re launching the 2024 Democracy Defense Drive
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83930070/469961784/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmYjBmZGQ2LTI5MDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=X5kqJ2P12CyuttOaqDEXY6AYYN_6YOZRUWAARIjmeI4=&emci=f6e0dbab-0f04-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=efb0fdd6-2906-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=8431045)

As a country, we have faced our fair share of challenges before. But this one’s different: **our democracy itself is under attack.** Right now, extreme, anti-democratic forces are using every tool they can to undermine the integrity of our elections. And that includes extreme partisan gerrymandering. **That’s why the NDRC is launching the 2024 Democracy Defense Drive — an all-out effort to rally the grassroots support we need to secure fair maps and protect our democracy by winning key elections this year.** [**I need to ask: Will you join me in this fight by making a donation of $3 or any amount today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83930072/469961785/-803236760?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_aprfun_email_20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_campaign=aprfun&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmYjBmZGQ2LTI5MDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=X5kqJ2P12CyuttOaqDEXY6AYYN_6YOZRUWAARIjmeI4=) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83930074/469961786/-803236760?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_aprfun_email_20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_campaign=aprfun&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmYjBmZGQ2LTI5MDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=X5kqJ2P12CyuttOaqDEXY6AYYN_6YOZRUWAARIjmeI4=) Make no mistake: if we lose this fight to defend our democracy, the attacks on our elections will only get worse. And the attempts by extreme, anti-democratic forces to rig the system in their favor – to effectively drown out people’s voices – will only get more brazen. But here’s why I’m optimistic: **their path to power is determined by people like you. And if enough of us do our part to protect our democracy, they will fail.** The NDRC is fighting all across the country to defeat GOP gerrymandering and win the races most crucial to a fair redistricting process — so everyone’s voice can be heard. But we need your help to get the job done. [**Our freedoms depend on a strong democracy. Let’s do everything we can to protect it. The NDRC is leading that charge, so I’m asking you to make a donation to support the 2024 Democracy Defense Drive today.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83930076/469961787/-803236760?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_aprfun_email_20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_campaign=aprfun&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmYjBmZGQ2LTI5MDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=X5kqJ2P12CyuttOaqDEXY6AYYN_6YOZRUWAARIjmeI4=) [DONATE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83930077/469961788/-803236760?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_aprfun_email_20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240429-NDRC-Red-PresObama_&utm_campaign=aprfun&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmYjBmZGQ2LTI5MDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=X5kqJ2P12CyuttOaqDEXY6AYYN_6YOZRUWAARIjmeI4=) Thanks to your support, we’ve scored some major victories for a fairer democracy. But we all know this is far from over. Our democracy is at its strongest when ordinary Americans come together, get engaged, and make their voices heard. With our democracy at risk, that’s never been more urgent. So I’m giving my all to this fight. Will you join me? More soon — thank you,

And the attempts by extreme, anti-democratic forces to rig the system in their favor – to effectively drown out people’s voices – will only get more brazen. But here’s why I’m optimistic: their path to power is determined by people like you. And if enough of us do our part to protect our democracy, they will fail.
