Fellow Conservative,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e477b96201954c148388a5ee605a5d45&_e=_tyLu3KPCnqjSiLS7bwVBoJRrrckmIOPr3SfSNYVKrrFRAzEexJYTvWy1eD0UWoS7NyCDoSpgK1GkDHGuAUmiH82baj0338OKOwjmHW890Ng1CxMCWawsyFADTnK_a7sX3fZSniJQDwCBoVbf9kpIcPck7Qb1f_7w_BIryKxbflfYoa3qEuyqjjQfzP5yTPnc8KbEGtAPbkxeeQetj-cChnkYlxXTO2gP9KBf_83Hf_zI6BBMAdXtPo8vhhLmKxMi9vSODc77tanRiK5CtsesVM45sP_YIqst4KONVILJHbIAi0mPOJz4JMpGWA0Z43U5jrFj3jOHbLCzviHZD5C5MzJ4teexd8-bxbnAlT9gYSNW4T7TVKZ3kEMxB6n8RsXhFpKvDfA0zIzodTAA6CBgkkO9IvdyeUFt9kXE-r_1us%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

3. Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. [**link to donate**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e477b96201954c148388a5ee605a5d45&_e=_tyLu3KPCnqjSiLS7bwVBoJRrrckmIOPr3SfSNYVKrrFRAzEexJYTvWy1eD0UWoS7NyCDoSpgK1GkDHGuAUmiH82baj0338OKOwjmHW890Ng1CxMCWawsyFADTnK_a7sX3fZSniJQDwCBoVbf9kpIcPck7Qb1f_7w_BIryKxbflfYoa3qEuyqjjQfzP5yTPnc8KbEGtAPbkxeeQetj-cChnkYlxXTO2gP9KBf_83Hf_zI6BBMAdXtPo8vhhLmKxMi9vSODc77tanRiK5CtseseKV2qo7r8DhVvwEl5WLQt52bmhMuDTV1grg9qD66KSmcUlLk4NoYrq4HB841DEmqhexEJZLzTIuU1B09xUDjcqFLHN94nurzaJWfNjWtYQoB6gAs97PFkW8tZJnfS9hRfEqXUBjG9wNHy44MecC-Gg%3D)

4. Since Tester announced his plans to run for reelection in early 2023, **he’s raised more than $31 million. He raised $7.25 million from January 1st to March 30th.**

My opponent writes that he’s “**stressed** ” and “**worried,** ” but I should be the one in this race who’s stressed and worried. We’re tied with my opponent in the poll, but he’s leaving me in the dust when it comes to fundraising.

I need help. I know you’re receiving many requests for help – I got 70 emails asking for money yesterday. I also know that resources are limited, but **I don’t know where else to turn.**

Last month alone, Jon Tester received donations from 61,000 Democrats. **[Surely, they’re 61,000 conservatives interested in helping me put him out to pasture, right?](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e477b96201954c148388a5ee605a5d45&_e=_tyLu3KPCnqjSiLS7bwVBoJRrrckmIOPr3SfSNYVKrrFRAzEexJYTvWy1eD0UWoS7NyCDoSpgK1GkDHGuAUmiH82baj0338OKOwjmHW890Ng1CxMCWawsyFADTnK_a7sX3fZSniJQDwCBoVbf9kpIcPck7Qb1f_7w_BIryKxbflfYoa3qEuyqjjQfzP5yTPnc8KbEGtAPbkxeeQetj-cChnkYlxXTO2gP9KBf_83Hf_zI6BBMAdXtPo8vhhLmKxMi9vSODc77tanRiK5CtsesUF19uVTD9Womxa8xNPIH6rmgUTGpO1WlftgI38Us4ai6pTZeDpuQXwtZNbwrUkD13nd9Hvyy3ZfwTVsFeBa_eH9w5bosrGjCN2iofKM1of6-KsrPFze42P6ELHe0i2sJYYJ7A7e2gDA58isa3ieXiM%3D)**
**
I hope you’ll act on this request for help when you see this email.**

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy
Former Navy SEAL
Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate

subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
I am fearful that legal persecution will intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values
[Unsubscribe](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWUiycOikN)

---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63116316:WUiycOikN:m:1:2627245898:31CF107A8E9BE183C34A269897C1F837:r) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63116316:WUiycOikN:m:1:2627245898:31CF107A8E9BE183C34A269897C1F837:r)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63116316:WUiycOikN:m:1:2627245898:31CF107A8E9BE183C34A269897C1F837:r)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

---
Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods to decrease the federal government's role in society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

body:
Please let me explain why this fight is so personal to me.
#
Peter,
Nearly every chance he’s had, Josh Hawley has voted against investing in our state.
**I’ve seen firsthand what it costs when politicians like him divide rather than deliver.** In the U.S. Senate, I’ll fight like hell to bring back every dollar I can to Missouri. And I’ll work with anyone to get it done.

[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/48967?refcode=em20240429-5393&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5393%2E614464%2EGERVQQ)

When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/48967?refcode=em20240429-5393&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5393%2E614464%2EGERVQQ)

**I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back.**
So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind.
**And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country** — so everyday people call the shots, not massive corporations or corrupt politicians. Since Hawley won this Senate seat with only 51% of the vote, Missourians have broken with him and taken back their power at the ballot box by voting to raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act, and legalize cannabis.
If we’re able to communicate to voters that our campaign is about taking this U.S. Senate seat back for real Missourians and fundamentally changing who has power in this country, we have a real shot at defeating Josh Hawley this November.

Are you tired of being told that everything is going fine in America today?

It's a big lie. It's a lie being told by Adam Schiff and Joe Biden (one of many) to stay in power. And it's a lie that good people like you are ALWAYS forced to pay the price for.

But it doesn't have to be that way.

Opening our borders is a **CHOICE**.

Siding with violent criminals over our brave police is a **CHOICE**.

Spending our country into an oblivion of debt and inflation is a **CHOICE**.

Allowing homelessness and addiction to render our streets and neighborhoods unsafe is a **CHOICE**.

Accepting failed public schools is a **CHOICE**.

And the ones making these "choices" for a combined 79 years in office?

body:
[View in Web Browser](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kM1u6jAQhZ9msiOyxxMGFl7AhVxVVbusytK1nWIUN8EOBHj6ipR2Oz_f-XRM7NvQXDXwGhD3wWVABLUCxONujOl0iM__Z8nctrPj_DVW9y3-A8Th2vu_0wel9NGE9j7lTeG0apygwmvJkkgQV6rY64UlwcbZuZPqo5HkFwsjjBUePTM6UwSNAkkQLmWlUHLJLL0nIVlU5JCWQGLKKU30KVgj8zCalLoulraLRav3w9DnSawGrMfUlV8n2_pT_nmzXQSsH8qA9RmwXl3i-pByc76BqqcW1OZt93552prqpUja9WNo25DnDCQ-fzHfAQAA___ODmDh)

If you've been led to believe that peanut butter, almonds and spinach are good for you, today's email might shock you and is important to read, because these 3 healthy foods could be contributing to health problems in your body.

Let's take a quick look at why...

**1\. Peanut butter**

While peanut butter does contain a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in the next food...

**2\. Spinach**

Spinach is promoted as a healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and joint pain.

In fact, some people have even gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

**3\. Almonds**

Although almonds and almond milk are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides, including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

Now let's take a look at a fun little quiz below and a few more foods...

**Bananas vs oranges vs apples... (the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)**
According to the best-selling author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry, there's one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can **damage your gut and disrupt your hormones**. Both sapping you of energy and **forcing your body to create "sticky" fat cells that can NOT be "burned off" with normal diet and exercise. **

Do you know the fruit I'm talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: RE: Gaslighting
body:
I wanted to go back to something real quick

Peter, my team sent the email below earlier this month.
When we sent it, Kari Lake was still trying to walk back her extreme stance on abortion — how she said it was the “ultimate sin” and called the Civil War-era ban that’s currently in place a “great law” when she was campaigning for governor.
You’ll never guess what happened after that.
She flipped again, doubling down on her anti-abortion extremism. Now she’s saying it’s “unfortunate” that Arizona officials aren’t planning to enforce this ban from 1864 that would jail nurses and doctors.
Yeah, the same ban she was running away from as fast as she could just a couple weeks ago. Go figure.
Look... what I know for sure is that we can’t afford Kari Lake in the U.S. Senate. Not only is she a flip-flopper, she’s dangerous. She’s a threat to the Constitution that I swore an oath to protect when I joined the Marines.
I need your help to make sure she never steps foot on the floor of the Senate. I need you to make a donation before our April fundraising deadline hits at midnight tomorrow.
Use this link and chip in if you care about stopping Kari Lake. I’d really appreciate it.
[**<https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/04-29-24> Thanks a lot, Ruben
* * *
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-apr24.p6MMmT&refcode=em240429-1-160&t=2&akid=2267%2E734936%2ESv35CY) Back in 2022, Kari Lake had this to say about the near-total abortion ban in Arizona: [](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-apr24.p6MMmT&refcode=em240429-1-160&t=3&akid=2267%2E734936%2ESv35CY) She had a lot to say about abortion bans back then. She called abortion the “ultimate sin” and was pushing to enforce this extreme ban during her last campaign. But at some point over the last year or so, she realized that restricting the rights that generations of women were born with is incredibly unpopular, and that this near-total ban on abortion from a law originally passed 160 years ago could hurt her chances at gaining more power and influence. So... she’s running from her past statements as fast as she possibly can. There’s a word for that: Gaslighting. If Kari Lake was so adamant about her support for abortion bans in 2022, why would anyone trust her now that she’s changed her tune? We won’t let Arizona forget that Kari Lake strongly supported this law, and that her hero Donald Trump made these abortion bans possible when he filled the Supreme Court with far-right justices. name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5-61gkk4kUymB2yspzLx8w~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5-61gkk4kUymB2yspzLx8w~~/AARclAA~) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5-61gkk4kUymB2yspzLx8w~~/AARclAA~)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

> **ORIGINAL LINK:[https://www.concordmonitor.com/My-Turn-Campus-Chaos-and-America-s-Character-54906469](https://substack.com/redirect/2e76fe94-1257-4a97-b6dd-9eb6a3d8dad2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Jewish students being warned to avoid college campuses for their own safety. [Angry mobs pounding on the doors of academic buildings containing Jewish scholars, who are told to hide in the attic](https://substack.com/redirect/f56ecefe-90c7-4618-b8fa-5e412d443bd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Streets filled with crowds chanting antisemitic slurs, telling Jews to "go back to Poland." Intimidation, harassment, and physical violence spreading like wildfire as a Jewish professor is denied access to his classroom and universities are shut down.
This isn't Nazi Germany in the 1930s. This is America in 2024. And the perpetrators aren't Nazi Brown Shirts; they're privileged college students at the country's most elite schools. [A violent spasm of antisemitism is creating campus chaos with an ugliness and viciousness that were heretofore unimaginable](https://substack.com/redirect/f387e8dd-430c-4acd-a009-9e1724c3295e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Ever since the horrific Oct. 7 attacks on Israel, these protests have only grown as academic leaders from Harvard to MIT to Penn, as well as other universities, have failed to display any semblance of moral clarity. Israel was attacked, Israelis were killed, raped, and tortured, and reports show that Israeli [babies were decapitated](https://substack.com/redirect/6add6d72-e0f9-493d-8264-6e1d0bc3bc04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or [burned alive](https://substack.com/redirect/6e1999f2-29bf-480f-83a0-5b304aecedce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And in response to these despicable acts, thousands have flooded the [streets and campuses across America to protest](https://substack.com/redirect/f56ecefe-90c7-4618-b8fa-5e412d443bd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)... against Israel. In the confused, bizarro world of such protestors, Israel is the aggressor. Calls for a ceasefire fail to recall there was a ceasefire on Oct. 6.
These protests are now openly supportive of terrorism, complete with calls for Intifada and praise for the Al-Qassam Brigades, the military arm of Hamas. "Glory to Our Martyrs" is proclaimed on signs and projected onto buildings as protesters honor Oct. 7 as a historic victory. Jewish students are taunted as being the "next targets" and told that "The 7th of October is going to be every day for you."
Ironically, these perverse protests aren't really about concern for the Palestinians or humanitarian aid or a ceasefire. These protests are now about hatred and venom, and this hatred and venom isn't only anti-Israel; it's antisemitic.
**There are calls for genocide. In America, in the 21st century. On Ivy League campuses.**
How did we end up here? As a student at Yale and MIT years ago, and a teacher at Yale and Harvard in the years since, I had a front row seat to this growing "illiberal liberalism." What started as political correctness morphed into safe spaces and speech codes, censorship and the de-platforming of conservative speakers. Academic leaders lived according to a new creed, one that promotes selective free speech: "free speech for me, but not for thee."
The new religion spilled beyond the academy and is now felt broadly across America. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives are replacing equality of opportunity with equity of outcomes. A new religion now describes everyone and everything as either oppressor or oppressed. This growing intolerance grew into a full-blown panic during the summer of 2020 in which rioters tore down statues of George Washington and burned American flags.
Within this framework, Israel is an oppressor, Palestine is the oppressed. The actions of the so-called "oppressed" are automatically justified and defendable, regardless of how violent or perverse. This warped thinking was on full display during recent congressional hearings in which the presidents of elite universities simply couldn't bring themselves to condemn calls for genocide, saying it depended on the context. A moral rot is metastasizing within our leading universities, and if we don't stop its spread, it threatens to destroy our society.
Sadly, it seems Americans no longer share a common understanding of our country and its history, what we stand for, and what it means to be an American. There was a time when terrorist attacks like those of Oct. 7 would have united our country in condemnation. Shockingly, we instead find ourselves in a country in which some are rooting for the terrorists. They are chanting "Death to America" on American campuses and raising the Palestinian flag.
Enough is enough. It's time to stop this nonsense. Students should be expelled and acts of violence should be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law. Foreign students who harass Jewish students or commit acts of violence and vandalism should have their student visas revoked and be deported immediately. Colleges and universities that cannot or will not protect their Jewish students should suffer consequences as well, having their federal funding suspended. Alumni should suspend donations to their alma maters. And under no circumstances should universities cancel graduations or force students into virtual classrooms. There should be thorough investigations, and university presidents should be forced to resign, or be fired.
It's time to define who we are as Americans. We need to strongly condemn hatred and bigotry, call out antisemitism, and stand firm against political violence in all its forms. There cannot be room in any democracy for acts of violence and intimidation. _Our very character as a nation is now at stake._
_**Vikram Mansharamani of Lincoln is a candidate for Congress in New Hampshire 's 2nd Congressional District. He was previously on the faculties of both Yale and Harvard.**_

| My district is home to almost 70,000 Veterans -- more than any other part of Texas. While every Veteran's story is unique, these are all folks who've answered the call to serve our country; whose sacrifices have helped shape and define who we are as Americans. For many, these are also folks who are anxious about what comes next.
Veterans living here know that this Republican Party has betrayed them -- time and time again, ever since Trump took over. The evidence is just too frequent, too public, and too damning to ignore:
---
| |

Let’s look back at how we got here >>>
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1199%2E62735%2EDqtoH1)
Can you believe it, Peter?
Today marks **_99 days until the Michigan Senate primary!_** That’s 99 days left until everything Hill has been advocating for — universal healthcare, environmental justice, cleaning up government corruption — goes head to head with the establishment at the ballot box.
**This is big stuff we’re talking about! Let’s take a quick trip down memory lane to see how far we’ve come ⤵️**
**_July 10th, 2023_**
The day Hill launched his grassroots campaign for Michigan’s open Senate seat! He’s so proud of how much we’ve grown and the endorsements we’ve earned since then. Together, we’re working towards a brighter future in Michigan and beyond.
**_February 16th, 2024_**
The day Hill submitted the required nominating petitions and officially filed to get his name on the ballot — the first candidate in this race to do so! It took a lot of grassroots volunteer support to get to this point, which makes it an even more special milestone on the road to the primary.
**_March 31st, 2024_**
The day our campaign stared down our biggest fundraising challenge to date — the first FEC quarterly deadline of 2024 — and it’s thanks to you that we filed a strong report. Hill isn’t taking a cent of corporate PAC money, so your support is _critical_ to our campaign.
**_August 6th, 2024_**
The big one: Primary Day! The outcome will determine who will face the GOP frontrunner, and it’s going to take _every single member_ of this grassroots team to beat the establishment and send Hill to the November General Election. Which brings us back to...
**_April 29th, 2024_**

The finale.

| | | | Texas Flynn Fest is only 24 days away! Due to the overwhelming response, we're temporarily reopening sponsorships for Texas Flynn Fest.
This event marks the finale of a 35-city nationwide tour that General Flynn is doing, and Texas Flynn Fest is on track to be the biggest yet!
(Btw, if you still need to pick your tickets up, [click here](https://jamesonellis.lt.acemlna.com/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cHMlM0ElMkYlMkZ0ZXhhc2ZseW5uZmVzdC5jb20=&sig=29UyYAmr9G5vL4VApZiN16bv3ctip75FgQJJtPZzRdVK&iat=1714425674&a=%7C%7C611311006%7C%7C&account=jamesonellis%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=zfdZ%2B5e2NKnuE%2BxteURqdpKzJTsuSgahIH5b%2B%2BgkV8uG5i4M%3ANYSMtf83thEfUDRmIIWqf%2BogbasWHXve&s=cabcbe31a720242486b887158a77876f&i=253A295A1A2266).)
You might know the perfect local business to join us.
**Why Sponsor?**
* **Get Noticed:** Businesses that sponsor Texas Flynn Fest will have their name prominently displayed on all our event materials, including banners, flyers, and social media posts. This extensive exposure is like a giant shoutout to everyone who comes, ensuring maximum visibility for their brand!
* **Save Money:** It's cheaper than buying lots of small ads and reaches way more people.
* **Uplift Our Community:** Sponsors play a crucial role in making our town vibrant and beneficial for everyone.
* **Expand Your Network:** This is a golden opportunity for local business owners to connect with potential customers who need their products or services.

Do you know a business that would be perfect for this? Or your favorite shop or service? Let them know they can be a big part of our festival!
Can you help us spread the word? We'd love to chat with them.
They can contact me directly at jameson@jamesonellis.com, or you can forward this email to them.
Thanks for helping us make Texas Flynn Fest the best one yet!

Over the weekend, the House voted to send Ukraine funding for a security package to help fight off the unjustified invasion ordered by Vladimir Putin.
Over 100 House Republicans, led by Marjorie Taylor Greene, voted against the Ukraine funding measure. Chief among them was one of Putin’s most reliable and talkative puppets: Jim Jordan.
It has already been exposed that Jordan was the architect of the failed impeachment effort of President Biden. Jordan hand-picked the man that the GOP chose as their star witness, Alexander Smirnov, whose complete and total lies were shown to be fabrications fed by Russian intelligence. Jordan eagerly accepted these lies with no evidence—happily doing Putin’s bidding if it served his and Trump’s interest.
This is why we say as often as possible that Jim Jordan is a threat to our national security and cannot be trusted in office. He has already endangered us, and he will do even more and worse if we allow him to return to Congress.
That’s why I am giving everything I have to this campaign. I am doing this for all of us, every American everywhere. The people of my district deserve a leader who will fight for them, and America needs us to run strong and win this crucial race.
Jordan will continue to abuse his power and put us all at risk if we don’t leave it all on the field in our work to defeat him. So I’m asking, as directly as possible: with so much at stake, can I count on you to stand with us and work to beat Jim Jordan in November for the good of the entire country? body:
Friend, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.
And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.

Fellow Conservative,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=dda0bccdb6cb49ca9ae9cbd7a6707096&_e=JE4jDtvx41A1euegb0fX7-jlGKsHDVwQdBaqAwq8Ooapq3EJkJhfPlSv_4dfPWn3dxltNXO7vZtYZg5Jg1dx2uuXrPgYnamB_ishLOz9bK1cfkGNALIIygQvmgaT9xzZHUPqPk4B4PMZRbJMqa4_NLTvl4EH5vQyXwM1PBQONpc-fZDDQ_XKigSj29L_zcBfzTTTDFX6DTg5BMlbkRrkcW_TArJD3xGvFNMJ_z04w_5IQ2z36PnhyxqArZ41eOXyYr70k5UTz9BhNoU-uL0ySZtunUG4sx3sOn97fEUzCxjIeOUQvXalo3Mlmk2IOHvCea9MCeFRcittTwZCg_h8I-RPP_sVVZ0Qg03pCQQxW92E-j6KRH2aKSBksbPTm2QVm3NldT1kKT-3yt_2ht7johX2sKrt1Wj6bInjNsKpDJY%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

3. Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. [**link to donate**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=dda0bccdb6cb49ca9ae9cbd7a6707096&_e=JE4jDtvx41A1euegb0fX7-jlGKsHDVwQdBaqAwq8Ooapq3EJkJhfPlSv_4dfPWn3dxltNXO7vZtYZg5Jg1dx2uuXrPgYnamB_ishLOz9bK1cfkGNALIIygQvmgaT9xzZHUPqPk4B4PMZRbJMqa4_NLTvl4EH5vQyXwM1PBQONpc-fZDDQ_XKigSj29L_zcBfzTTTDFX6DTg5BMlbkRrkcW_TArJD3xGvFNMJ_z04w_5IQ2z36PnhyxqArZ41eOXyYr70k5UTz9BhNoU-uL0ySZATfpHZIbOPWRdyER7wPcnH9lhS0VXJtm7ElGbPM1YB0IPOGso831dcGKWF7qcVWAi9gR7HdHMhV0_8aOASqo5C7S-7aN9M0XExSE-H6d3pwfYzPrytOD_j_R3QKZ2m0HpcbHoeZSqVkn9YeFGccLI%3D)

4. Since Tester announced his plans to run for reelection in early 2023, **he’s raised more than $31 million. He raised $7.25 million from January 1st to March 30th.**

My opponent writes that he’s “**stressed** ” and “**worried,** ” but I should be the one in this race who’s stressed and worried. We’re tied with my opponent in the poll, but he’s leaving me in the dust when it comes to fundraising.

I need help. I know you’re receiving many requests for help – I got 70 emails asking for money yesterday. I also know that resources are limited, but **I don’t know where else to turn.**

Last month alone, Jon Tester received donations from 61,000 Democrats. **[Surely, they’re 61,000 conservatives interested in helping me put him out to pasture, right?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=dda0bccdb6cb49ca9ae9cbd7a6707096&_e=JE4jDtvx41A1euegb0fX7-jlGKsHDVwQdBaqAwq8Ooapq3EJkJhfPlSv_4dfPWn3dxltNXO7vZtYZg5Jg1dx2uuXrPgYnamB_ishLOz9bK1cfkGNALIIygQvmgaT9xzZHUPqPk4B4PMZRbJMqa4_NLTvl4EH5vQyXwM1PBQONpc-fZDDQ_XKigSj29L_zcBfzTTTDFX6DTg5BMlbkRrkcW_TArJD3xGvFNMJ_z04w_5IQ2z36PnhyxqArZ41eOXyYr70k5UTz9BhNoU-uL0ySWmy45WukMTyBB0JqlfhFTnuGR4Musbv1MnmEMsWunUYaRmYiT9wU40U-kYEjdbvcSvIcRbkxIVYG8v9CjZ8T3Fc3fbovmCiR39nXKy97FCxy1ceXVTv2HMoG3mcmQTbMVaAoGKOOsV2s5VJzLB36MY%3D)**
**
I hope you’ll act on this request for help when you see this email.**

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy
Former Navy SEAL
Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate

1970 was a defining year for me. It was the first time I was arrested while traveling the country encouraging soldiers returning from war to speak about the injustices happening overseas. Coincidentally, another movement was afoot that year: 20 million people gathered for the very first Earth Day demonstration in the United States. Since then, activists and scientists have been sounding the alarm on the irreparable damage the fossil fuel industry and other corporate polluters inflict on the air we breathe, our wildlife and fragile ecosystems, and the water we depend on. Yet, despite these clear warnings, the fossil fuel industry deftly escapes accountability at nearly every turn. They continually wield their financial power — buying elections and spreading misinformation — to safeguard their profits at any cost. **[In the face of such overwhelming odds, every contribution to our cause is a step towards dismantling this destructive power. Can I count on you to donate to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC today this Earth Month?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83961904/470050650/2105508926?refcode=ea.2384d026-4e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.2384d026-4e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIzODRkMDI2LTRlMDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rFZ98JeerFiy43jo4JK3O_G3_P98s7f_Jw6tWDbf6Y4=)** Those early days in the 70s solidified my lifelong commitment to activism. While we still have so much work to do, it’s important to remember that by the end of the year, the Nixon Administration established the Environmental Protection Agency to address many of the concerns about pollution at the heart of the first Earth Day movement. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83961906/470050651/2105508926?refcode=ea.2384d026-4e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.2384d026-4e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIzODRkMDI2LTRlMDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rFZ98JeerFiy43jo4JK3O_G3_P98s7f_Jw6tWDbf6Y4=) I’m still as committed as ever to protesting, marching, and demanding more from our elected officials, but it has become clear to me that too many of them aren’t getting the message. The science is clear on what we need to do to avoid climate catastrophe. But if we can’t change the minds of the people in power, we need to change the people in power. That is why I'm channeling all my energy _(and don’t let 86 years young fool ya, I’ve got a LOT of it)_ into electing bold climate champions through the Jane Fonda Climate PAC and joining the chorus of voices demanding more for the communities being hit hardest by the climate crisis. **We've come so far, but there's still so much to do. clean_body: We’re in this together. | 1970 was a defining year for me. It was the first time I was arrested while traveling the country encouraging soldiers returning from war to speak about the injustices happening overseas. Coincidentally, another movement was afoot that year: 20 million people gathered for the very first Earth Day demonstration in the United States. Since then, activists and scientists have been sounding the alarm on the irreparable damage the fossil fuel industry and other corporate polluters inflict on the air we breathe, our wildlife and fragile ecosystems, and the water we depend on. Yet, despite these clear warnings, the fossil fuel industry deftly escapes accountability at nearly every turn. They continually wield their financial power — buying elections and spreading misinformation — to safeguard their profits at any cost. = Those early days in the 70s solidified my lifelong commitment to activism. While we still have so much work to do, it’s important to remember that by the end of the year, the Nixon Administration established the Environmental Protection Agency to address many of the concerns about pollution at the heart of the first Earth Day movement. = I’m still as committed as ever to protesting, marching, and demanding more from our elected officials, but it has become clear to me that too many of them aren’t getting the message. The science is clear on what we need to do to avoid climate catastrophe. But if we can’t change the minds of the people in power, we need to change the people in power. That is why I'm channeling all my energy (and don’t let 86 years young fool ya, I’ve got a LOT of it) into electing bold climate champions through the Jane Fonda Climate PAC and joining the chorus of voices demanding more for the communities being hit hardest by the climate crisis. We've come so far, but there's still so much to do. Fellow Conservative,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c41821c0c4a84fcaa279b34e5a271c99&_e=tUGibsVKpDRB6baWLrfBh_yz9FL61BHuRfSJh6ltsEz3cixOuCS3QYBOFKHDbjwJCt38wda3EGVfttBWDDBJvVaEL7U7X5BzGOyCG7zD37hg4zh1GWHs1QCmMiXXjwfj5HRn5hjzN4WzX8dfWYnx2Z1Aobq8UiuIqBgfAaQGuhxuxL8jU60yXNvNzaelJDnGpdjVjcISPHucYhkzISyJyUciDCWHQBAYQs595QQrt1SkGn38oZnSUSczoJrR-LQ0gZLVy1U1jWut7SwOUcA16vykjvwRvLfT4FySV-kc543LhLHeOln7wS8tP12ggh2f7yefGz42lWsrEVsWaZG7qm4ykB4WylV-JySF7dhj5ZIkcKiQjFdhOijHYbgLzqhMTrItR3aBQAjtt3mamf63yTvB7W0v2HSkNKRKG4p7CzQ%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

3. Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. [**link to donate**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c41821c0c4a84fcaa279b34e5a271c99&_e=tUGibsVKpDRB6baWLrfBh_yz9FL61BHuRfSJh6ltsEz3cixOuCS3QYBOFKHDbjwJCt38wda3EGVfttBWDDBJvVaEL7U7X5BzGOyCG7zD37hg4zh1GWHs1QCmMiXXjwfj5HRn5hjzN4WzX8dfWYnx2Z1Aobq8UiuIqBgfAaQGuhxuxL8jU60yXNvNzaelJDnGpdjVjcISPHucYhkzISyJyUciDCWHQBAYQs595QQrt1SkGn38oZnSUSczoJrR-LQ0gZLVy1U1jWut7SwOUcA16tGnBYqQpk2j-EQmuZbm-UrDIoF_cHe3BG9mQOw03sda4Hj4FNOIwGUHGhMl1nHW25VHRcS77F-8HfNMLpscx4iMhIUdVvyAmamsvC3PB9dppqRg3CjtkkWg1wHubZBjYDSeW7s7d3x86nEOjeFqn3M%3D)

4. Since Tester announced his plans to run for reelection in early 2023, **he’s raised more than $31 million. He raised $7.25 million from January 1st to March 30th.**

name: Dani Hupper, Evergreen
subject: We owe these people a big "thank you"
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
They've been working tirelessly for four years
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2511859/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Friend,

As spring settles in across the country, the two most polluting sectors in our economy—power and transportation—are looking at an entirely different future, thanks to President Biden's EPA.

It's hard to believe, but in the last two months, they've: |
---
|
* Set stronger rules on mercury and air toxins, wastewater, and coal ash. **This means many tons of extremely hazardous pollution will be reduced, saving lives and leading to better health in our communities.**

|
---
|
* Set the first-ever national limits on climate pollution from power plants, requiring most coal and new gas plants to cut those emissions by 90 percent, **which means important progress for the climate and less pollution for communities living near power plants.**

|
---
|
* Finalized stronger standards for pollution from heavy-duty trucks and cars, cutting emissions from the most carbon-polluting sector in our economy **and delivering meaningful health benefits, particularly in communities that have long called for action to address the unfair dangers they face from traffic pollution.**

[**Will you join us in saying "thank you" to the hardworking people at EPA who made this tremendous progress happen?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2511860/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[SHOW YOUR SUPPORT](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2511861/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **This was a group effort.** This historic progress is the direct result of a lot of good advocacy by climate and community activists, and we need you to keep using your voice to call for urgent climate action. But it also wouldn't have happened without the determined and strategic work of EPA staff, and anyone who cares about our communities and our future owes them a huge debt of gratitude.

[**Join us in saying "thank you" now.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2511862/87SdQ4wZ)

Sincerely, |
---
| | | [ ](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2511863/87SdQ4wZ)
---
### Dani Hupper
Campaigns Director
Evergreen Action

We’ve seen how it threatens the integrity and stability of the systems we rely on to protect and guide our nation. body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Congress voted last week to send billions more in weapons to Israel.
Bernie made it clear to his colleagues in the Senate that their votes for
this funding bill went against what the American people want and would
continue U.S. complicity in the murder of Palestinian civilians.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16984?t=1011&akid=5886%2E5885482%2EO_7uPI ][IMG]

A majority of Americans didn’t want Congress and President Biden to send
Netanyahu more bombs. They did it anyway. But President Biden still has
the opportunity to broker a lasting Peace and it’s the only path forward
to end the murder of Palestinians and starvation of over 1 million people
in Gaza.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16983?source=email-20240429&t=1012&akid=5886%2E5885482%2EO_7uPI ]Add your name: CEASEFIRE NOW! The only way towards Peace is diplomacy,
humanitarian aid, and the end of Netanyahu’s war.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16983?source=email-20240429&t=1013&akid=5886%2E5885482%2EO_7uPI ]ADD YOUR NAME

Meanwhile, many lawmakers in Congress and Netanyahu are scrambling to
defend the murder of Palestinians any way they can. Congress and President
Biden are taking the hypocritical, immoral position of recognizing the
disastrous humanitarian situation in Gaza and STILL sending more bombs to
Israel. The majority of the American people see through it.

Before the vote, Bernie said, “What we are doing today is very bad policy.
We are aiding and abetting the destruction of the Palestinian people. What
we are doing today is not what the American people want.”

How can President Biden and other lawmakers express concern over the grave
humanitarian situation in Gaza, with over 1 million Palestinians facing
starvation, then send more bombs to Netanyahu’s military?

The only way forward is for President Biden to use his power to broker an
immediate, diplomatice Peace in Israel-Palestine.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16983?source=email-20240429&t=1014&akid=5886%2E5885482%2EO_7uPI ]Add your name: The U.S. must broker a Ceasefire and end its complicity
with the atrocities against the Palestinian people.

When we organize, we win.

name: Sara (personal)
subject: What happens if Democrats lose in November?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
It’s impossible to plan for this year’s elections without finding yourself thinking about what will happen if Democrats lose.
I don’t want to write an email about how the sky is falling and all hope is lost – because I just don’t believe that.
But I do want to be realistic about the stakes of these elections.
In the lead-up to 2016, a lot of people said we were “exaggerating” the stakes, or that we were “making too big a deal” out of a potential Trump presidency.
But we knew then – and we know now – that no one was exaggerating. We all watched what Donald Trump did to our country while he was in the Oval Office, and we’re still only starting to experience the devastating consequences of what he was able to do to the Supreme Court.
From the gut-wrenching decision that overturned Roe v. Wade to the painful desecration of our democracy, the impacts of electing Trump and his followers can’t be overstated.
November might feel like it’s a long way off, but the truth is that elections aren’t won on Election Day or even in the final weeks of a race. They’re won by the candidates who are able to build up real resources over the course of a long runway – so they can do the hard work of persuading, educating, and turning out voters.
So that means that NOW is the time to act if we want to prevent Trump and his acolytes – like my opponent – from winning elections.
If you can, please chip in any amount today to boost up my re-election campaign’s April fundraising efforts. Your support will help me defeat my own MAGA opponent and support my fellow Democrats who are going up against extreme, right-wing candidates. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much for anything you’re able to give. Your support means a lot to me.
-Sara

Peter,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4fa4dfa676cf43288ec436110807e770&_e=3KrZwNfxEVYOUqyqhwyi0CWD4ghxp0hjq0jNlwKqvSJzzeMJwiWx547WBQti6idJrrk-mdcd-jkqNjTsTovMoP8Axn-fkq4SHfGbnM4NYCoAJ2kZ-xb8Bxz0AhPJQ3vrgRevpfaynHkn0awzEB2cDsY7ysO-YUE3PveXU1swSZTA4JbU9lHH1kLKBqPhKkfKzw5gEZOUw1j6v4Pe3x3Z7Ga5FYkeudGBLtwUOZol0_fxWOySxDntjctPY9k2cR9JAHnKIcpPoaqEu81F8fJNvpOV8wOlG4GjgQldLWP6jUNBcW2P2h1LVwlIVZ35K9dCPsmbN_l3-osB2yNteR0JtilSAziTko8jCTC3-Gokg57WEpeMzMFBqPVrBG9egU6uOBOq00T_7t_tJUlIW7wEA6uzW6DlXgTo_iymo9G8Di8%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

friends, I have a bigger favor to ask today. I know it's more than usual.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
My dad, Bob Lorinser, is running for Congress and has a mere 100 days until his primary election. Only then can he take our fight to GOP extremist Rep. Jack Bergman.
To get Democrats across the finish line in August, I'm contacting to see if you would be willing to be one of 100 $100 donors today? I know it's a lot, but hear me out...
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately.
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext?express_lane=true&amount=100&refcode=express_lane_100]
ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Friends,
I understand $100 is more than Dad typically asks for. His average grassroots contribution from extraordinary people like you is $35, and we're very grateful for every penny.
In fact, whether you contribute 100 pennies or 100 dimes, every donation helps our team thrive. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
However, in addition, today, if I can just rally the support of 100 people before tomorrow's end-of-the-month deadline, it will empower us to knock on 10,000 more doors , significantly boosting our voter outreach.
This month, we're already out in neighborhoods, every day, engaging with voters. This direct voter interaction is crucial to our campaign's success. It's where campaigns are won.
Spring and Summer come with additional expenses, and your support today ensures that every volunteer and staffer is equipped with the resources they need to talk with more voters and help Dad win big in August.
A strong showing in the primary gives us the momentum we need to go strong against Bergman in November and finally defeat Trumpism in rural America.
If you're able, this would put us over the top for the first month of Q2, and if we keep crushing our goals, we will do big good things.
Time is of the essence, every penny goes a long way, nothing goes to waste, and we will not let you down.
Thank you for your consideration.
-Andrew

Derek, today, I’m
reflecting on some of my earliest days in politics.

In the middle of such a consequential election season, it can be easy to
lose sight of our very modest beginnings. But for me, remembering where I
came from, and the difficulties we have faced along the way is so
important to appreciating all those who made it possible, and how much
people are depending on me.

Before my run for the U.S. Senate or my tenure in the U.S. House of
Representatives was even a thought, I served as California State Senator
from 1996 to 2000. While going through family photos with Eve this
weekend, we stumbled across this one:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=apr2024_abs_em.I2BRAI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240429_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6346%2E5257348%2EuMaOWh ]Adam and Eve posing for a photo during Adam's State Senate campaign

We were so young then! Eve has been my steadfast supporter since I told
her I wanted to run for office. There’s someone else who’s been a constant
since those early days,
Derek: you.

I lost my first race for the State Assembly. And my second. Only in my
third race — this time for the State Senate — was I successful. No matter
how big the challenge, this incredible team has helped us push forward. I
haven’t walked any part of this path alone, and as Election Day gets
closer, it’s a relief to know you’re by my side.

That said,
Derek, I’m asking for your
support again today. We’re just one day away from our crucial end-of-month
fundraising deadline, and we’re falling behind.

You’ve picked me up time and time again when fundraising deadlines were
tight, and I’m confident we can make up the distance in no time. Your
encouragement has helped me fight for abortion rights, advocate for
climate change solutions, defend our democracy, and so much more. And
again, I only have the privilege of doing this job because of you.

subject: ICYMI: Senator Dave Min Battles Utility Giants Over Ratepayer Rights
body:
Dave Min takes a bold stand against corporate greed, pushing for crucial legislation to protect Californians from manipulative utility spending | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/449684121794/icymi-senator-dave-min-battles-utility-giants-over-ratepayer-rights-16195799?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** April 29, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**ICYMI: Senator Dave Min Battles Utility Giants Over Ratepayer Rights**
_Democratic Congressional Candidate Dave Min takes a bold stand against corporate greed, pushing for crucial legislation to protect Californians from manipulative utility spending_
**IRVINE, CA** — Earlier this week, SB 938, a bill introduced by California State Senator Dave Min which would have prohibited investor-owned utilities from charging their political activities to ratepayers, failed by one vote in the Senate’s Energy and Utilities Committee. At a time when electric and gas utilities have been spiking, this commonsense bill would have ended the outrageous practices of utility companies like PG&E of lobbying regulators and legislators– including for rate increases to cover the costs of expensive new projects– and then sticking customers with the tab for these political activities.

**“The failure of SB 938, which would have reined in the excessive political influence of the big utility companies, is a stark reminder that even in states like California, special interests wield far too much power over the legislative and regulatory process,”** said Senator Min. **“While I am disappointed in this result, I am undeterred. When I am elected to Congress, I will keep on fighting against corruption and undue influence by big businesses, just as I have done my whole career. Americans deserve a government that works for them, not for the highest bidder.”**

Senator Min is the Democratic candidate running in the hotly contested race to succeed Katie Porter in California’s 47th Congressional District. The contrasts between Min and his Republican opponent Scott Baugh could not be starker. A former University of California Irvine Law Professor who began his legal career prosecuting corporate fraud at the SEC, Min has spent his career in public service fighting for a fairer economy and more transparency and integrity in our government. Scott Baugh, a career lobbyist who was indicted for 22 counts of campaign finance fraud and related charges and was also implicated in a criminal conspiracy to illegally register voters without their consent, has spent his career trying to use his high-level GOP connections to personally enrich himself. Min is the only candidate in this race who has sworn off corporate PAC money. And while Baugh has taken thousands of dollars in blood money from Big Oil and the gun lobby, Min is endorsed by Sierra Club and the Brady Campaign.

Min introduced SB 938 in response to news reports finding that investor-owned utilities had systematically engaged in political influence campaigns intended to weaken the laws and regulations overseeing them and also to lobby for more rate increases, and then had charged these activities to ratepayers. Last year, it came to light that the Southern California Gas Company (SoCalGas) had spent at least $36 million on political activities meant to undermine the state’s clean energy rules. More recently, PG&E admitted that its $6 million TV ad campaign to try to push for more rate increases was charged to ratepayers. Despite existing federal laws that technically prevent utilities from billing ratepayers for lobbying expenses, these regulations contain loopholes that have enabled utilities nationwide to use ratepayer funds for political lobbying.
_###

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

More recently, PG&E admitted that its $6 million TV ad campaign to try to push for more rate increases was charged to ratepayers. Despite existing federal laws that technically prevent utilities from billing ratepayers for lobbying expenses, these regulations contain loopholes that have enabled utilities nationwide to use ratepayer funds for political lobbying. California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. | | Our mailing address is: PO Box 5959, Irvine, CA 92616 | This email was sent to mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com Dave Min For Senate PO Box 5959 Irvine, CA 92616-5959 * USA

Failing schools, bans on women’s reproductive health care, hospitals closing, and kids going hungry. We’ve got to do something about it. Unlike Marsha Blackburn, I’m not content with the status quo. This race is our chance to turn our state around. I won’t give up on Tennessee. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Let’s do this, Gloria = | = Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. name: Center for Reproductive Rights
subject: How do abortion bans influence college decisions?
body:
Half of U.S. states have banned or severely restricted abortion | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83973299/470080428/2141984067?sourceid=1149540&utm_campaign=24emcl042423aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=collegedecisions&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDczOWRhNS01ZTA2LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uicbav6K-VtO2KaOyg3DxnMBwhQD8jmHvXGN6fnCLgA=&emci=cc7cffda-2003-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ed739da5-5e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=954237) | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83973304/470080431/2141984067?sourceid=1149540&utm_campaign=24emcl042423aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=collegedecisions&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDczOWRhNS01ZTA2LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uicbav6K-VtO2KaOyg3DxnMBwhQD8jmHvXGN6fnCLgA=&emci=cc7cffda-2003-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ed739da5-5e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=954237)
---|---
| Peter, May 1 is “National College Decision Day” in the United States, when millions of students will officially commit to their college of choice. While students consider a number of factors when deciding on what college to attend—such as affordability, academics, and campus life—one concern is of growing importance: **access to abortion care.**

It has been two years since the U.S. Supreme Court eliminated the constitutional right to abortion, and [**abortion is now banned or severely restricted in half of U.S. states.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83973308/470080434/1777352126?sourceid=1149540&utm_campaign=24emcl042423aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=collegedecisions&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDczOWRhNS01ZTA2LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uicbav6K-VtO2KaOyg3DxnMBwhQD8jmHvXGN6fnCLgA=&emci=cc7cffda-2003-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ed739da5-5e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=954237) In the post-_Roe_ landscape, that means millions of young people will be heading to colleges in places with far fewer options to manage unintended pregnancies.

An overwhelming majority of currently enrolled and prospective college students said reproductive health care policies are important in their enrollment decisions, according to the Lumina Foundation-Gallup 2024 State of Higher Education Study: **[71% say state reproductive health care policies
impact college choice](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83973312/470080437/-888872702?sourceid=1149540&utm_campaign=24emcl042423aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=collegedecisions&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDczOWRhNS01ZTA2LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uicbav6K-VtO2KaOyg3DxnMBwhQD8jmHvXGN6fnCLgA=&emci=cc7cffda-2003-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ed739da5-5e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=954237)
AND
[80% of all current/prospective students
prefer states with greater access](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83973315/470080440/-888872702?sourceid=1149540&utm_campaign=24emcl042423aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=collegedecisions&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDczOWRhNS01ZTA2LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uicbav6K-VtO2KaOyg3DxnMBwhQD8jmHvXGN6fnCLgA=&emci=cc7cffda-2003-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ed739da5-5e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=954237)** And it’s not just college students: in a study published in the _Journal of Medical Ethics_ , more than half (58%) of the medical students surveyed said they were unlikely to apply for residency programs in states with abortion restrictions. Because of these restrictions, maternal health care deserts are cropping up across the country, and these findings only point to a worsening of that crisis. With abortion laws rapidly shifting across the U.S., the Center for Reproductive Rights’ [**'After _Roe_ Fell' map tracks abortion laws by state and is updated in real time by our team of legal experts.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83973318/470080443/1777352126?sourceid=1149540&utm_campaign=24emcl042423aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=collegedecisions&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDczOWRhNS01ZTA2LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uicbav6K-VtO2KaOyg3DxnMBwhQD8jmHvXGN6fnCLgA=&emci=cc7cffda-2003-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ed739da5-5e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=954237) The interactive map is an incredible resource that can help you stay up to date on the legal status of abortion in your state, or any other. | [**EXPLORE THE MAP**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83973321/470080446/1777352126?sourceid=1149540&utm_campaign=24emcl042423aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=collegedecisions&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDczOWRhNS01ZTA2LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uicbav6K-VtO2KaOyg3DxnMBwhQD8jmHvXGN6fnCLgA=&emci=cc7cffda-2003-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ed739da5-5e06-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=954237 "EXPLORE THE MAP")
---
Abortion bans impact all of us, Peter. We know anti-abortion extremists want to ban abortion nationwide, and they will do whatever it takes for that to happen, from banning abortion to eliminating access to medication abortion, to gutting rights to emergency care.

But we won't let that happen.

Thank you for staying aware and informed on your reproductive rights. We’re so grateful you're with us.

Onward,
Center for Reproductive Rights

clean_body: Half of U.S. states have banned or severely restricted abortion | | ---|--- | Peter, May 1 is “National College Decision Day” in the United States, when millions of students will officially commit to their college of choice. While students consider a number of factors when deciding on what college to attend—such as affordability, academics, and campus life—one concern is of growing importance: access to abortion care. It has been two years since the U.S. Supreme Court eliminated the constitutional right to abortion, and In the post-Roe landscape, that means millions of young people will be heading to colleges in places with far fewer options to manage unintended pregnancies. An overwhelming majority of currently enrolled and prospective college students said reproductive health care policies are important in their enrollment decisions, according to the Lumina Foundation-Gallup 2024 State of Higher Education Study: AND And it’s not just college students: in a study published in the Journal of Medical Ethics , more than half (58%) of the medical students surveyed said they were unlikely to apply for residency programs in states with abortion restrictions. Because of these restrictions, maternal health care deserts are cropping up across the country, and these findings only point to a worsening of that crisis. With abortion laws rapidly shifting across the U.S., the Center for Reproductive Rights’ The interactive map is an incredible resource that can help you stay up to date on the legal status of abortion in your state, or any other. | "EXPLORE THE MAP" Abortion bans impact all of us, Peter. We know anti-abortion extremists want to ban abortion nationwide, and they will do whatever it takes for that to happen, from banning abortion to eliminating access to medication abortion, to gutting rights to emergency care. But we won't let that happen. Thank you for staying aware and informed on your reproductive rights. We’re so grateful you're with us. body:
| | |
---
Friend, my motto has always been that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. That's what I'm doing every day in the Senate.
**I'm fighting for the Dignity of Work.** No matter where you're from or what kind of work you do, hard work should pay off for everyone. Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you.
**I'm fighting for accountability.** For years, we've seen corporations lobby for tax breaks and bad trade deals that hurt workers. I'm not afraid to stand up to Wall Street or take on Big Pharma to level the playing field.
**I'm fighting for our fundamental rights.** My opponent has made it clear he doesn’t have our best interests at heart. I will always fight for a more equal and inclusive country.
**But here's the deal, friend: I need you to fight with me.** I'm facing my toughest race yet, and polls show me neck and neck with my Trump-backed opponent. He’s spending millions of dollars to flip this seat and the Senate red, and I can't fight back without your help.

_The New York Times_ is writing a story filled with frivolous lies about my childhood.

Growing up, we lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dc7454aaeb14ed180e3fe477a8f86d7&_e=5FYxDkWiJW-rS-NYYH2H4TOgbtQLuB6kGaXNRr-VqPeVofEYpU5LGzfsZW7tWZHY6gkjjIx7o6M5FAmpo1EmiWoQXo6xtSjrZZNKU6MDeaUKogX7TONzFUZ77MmBPlv6MG_oAvhb1dmODrmnUnVgU-8d0jUULEWAfTn0_tvXvSGKLurYgAZhThD3n6Qvw2_YeKM3n4rTsNUqo3h3mIAqaFsScm-ZTv5Ed0VBImGua_sEz-9Q0obcYYXTf4DSOpv_oJ8zut0osfneNTOo1peAQpIppXTQAHoUQ5ZWG8b98rH_dW5wfMUZyOqQEiVs7VBO6WvxC9XuVHDWpItQ1VCp5VU1_lVR6VgMsDodii8X1FmyulEs579aj1sNK8yWei-X)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dc7454aaeb14ed180e3fe477a8f86d7&_e=5FYxDkWiJW-rS-NYYH2H4TOgbtQLuB6kGaXNRr-VqPeVofEYpU5LGzfsZW7tWZHY6gkjjIx7o6M5FAmpo1EmiWoQXo6xtSjrZZNKU6MDeaUKogX7TONzFUZ77MmBPlv6MG_oAvhb1dmODrmnUnVgU-8d0jUULEWAfTn0_tvXvSGKLurYgAZhThD3n6Qvw2_YeKM3n4rTsNUqo3h3mIAqaFsScm-ZTv5Ed0VBImGua_u_Li9C3tpyTdGc5USsrT5bcBzXfxqjZn0zucx8YBLkyUieXDWHcQlYxj_C1-RQMrl0sRRxoUCebBKwqvva7EZQVbIUuYEpuTLNJ_9odjWx6zyys_XRhXVaOCMsfjzMj2hzk60rZDjLMl0ZFv6i6CCV)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg State University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dc7454aaeb14ed180e3fe477a8f86d7&_e=5FYxDkWiJW-rS-NYYH2H4TOgbtQLuB6kGaXNRr-VqPeVofEYpU5LGzfsZW7tWZHY6gkjjIx7o6M5FAmpo1EmiWoQXo6xtSjrZZNKU6MDeaUKogX7TONzFUZ77MmBPlv6MG_oAvhb1dmODrmnUnVgU-8d0jUULEWAfTn0_tvXvSGKLurYgAZhThD3n6Qvw2_YeKM3n4rTsNUqo3h3mIAqaFsScm-ZTv5Ed0VBImGua_ulK2nndhy2iZaKwUylE61T6TK2fuc9bsdseXfZy8kyEHMPQjUYXgCH-Vpdz7IHRGLP-FDb01zjzRQ8ybkkgM7q5-fi3-uBOEsQABdIunkzkPOZosQDkdX1AnIEG2cJFIiboPK81FDy-Nr9eeBswvza)
It's incredible to me that this New York Times reporter somehow thinks this fact makes my dad "politically connected." **Does she know I 'm running against a career politician who's been riding his father's political coattails in elected office for three decades?**

I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg.
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dc7454aaeb14ed180e3fe477a8f86d7&_e=5FYxDkWiJW-rS-NYYH2H4TOgbtQLuB6kGaXNRr-VqPeVofEYpU5LGzfsZW7tWZHY6gkjjIx7o6M5FAmpo1EmiWoQXo6xtSjrZZNKU6MDeaUKogX7TONzFUZ77MmBPlv6MG_oAvhb1dmODrmnUnVgU-8d0jUULEWAfTn0_tvXvSGKLurYgAZhThD3n6Qvw2_YeKM3n4rTsNUqo3h3mIAqaFsScm-ZTv5Ed0VBImGua_uDUl1KUz2iEoedIXcHkyu0DJhm6pnn9rLSQ4jgITVEtsI4NaiIHy2R6BCnvzFGtc5iLnr3AoBSsm_8Fk5ndQcJX6kvYiZkOnZnEaHDnc3kPBgT5EYoy3E24pkAA1areIDqddZorJkmHHRFR2C_AAng)
It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point.

](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dc7454aaeb14ed180e3fe477a8f86d7&_e=5FYxDkWiJW-rS-NYYH2H4TOgbtQLuB6kGaXNRr-VqPeVofEYpU5LGzfsZW7tWZHY6gkjjIx7o6M5FAmpo1EmiWoQXo6xtSjrZZNKU6MDeaUKogX7TONzFUZ77MmBPlv6MG_oAvhb1dmODrmnUnVgU-8d0jUULEWAfTn0_tvXvSGKLurYgAZhThD3n6Qvw2_YeKM3n4rTsNUqo3h3mIAqaFsScm-ZTv5Ed0VBImGua_tu_LXB51Xs3ExVHufuwL0fS7W5ximg2CEd0xQt9JPCoXLPCfcq76S-WcjPVbXfykPRqMCRSLlA5YKUw58F7_i4qgWxuKFgmtacfkXoLCzSabfAfcop0PCH3YHbE2DQB8MfuLJLUszdvfxy0ruIPrwr)

[

](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dc7454aaeb14ed180e3fe477a8f86d7&_e=5FYxDkWiJW-rS-NYYH2H4TOgbtQLuB6kGaXNRr-VqPeVofEYpU5LGzfsZW7tWZHY6gkjjIx7o6M5FAmpo1EmiWoQXo6xtSjrZZNKU6MDeaUKogX7TONzFUZ77MmBPlv6MG_oAvhb1dmODrmnUnVgU-8d0jUULEWAfTn0_tvXvSGKLurYgAZhThD3n6Qvw2_YeKM3n4rTsNUqo3h3mIAqaFsScm-ZTv5Ed0VBImGua_sy-p-j-VCJ-an8N_qNAKxIwh8ZQizLMZyrRJYNoDfUFZ8-BDLB3K7KVGwfKhACQgIWgOkNX-pEEEstrBfuvtpiraMrqnD_XminATBymaSXOuv_M5ZHIUV4jsYnf5PlIk_ksbuOOVZvb16IQuc3Rg3g)
**It 's a shame this reporter from New York City doesn't want to tell that story. I think it's a pretty great one.**

[1]Powered By People

Here’s what Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fighting for Reproductive Rights

Texas’ extreme abortion ban continues to force women to carry dangerous,
nonviable pregnancies that could kill them. While the law is supposed to
provide medical exceptions in cases where a woman’s life is at risk, the
language is too vague to protect doctors who could face life in prison for
performing an emergency abortion.

Texas sued the Biden Administration over federal guidance that physicians
are able to perform abortions if the operation would stabilize a patient
experiencing a medical emergency.

This November, we have an extraordinary chance to re-elect President Biden
and secure a pro-choice majority in both the House and Senate. If we do
that, we can pass nationwide abortion protections and reverse these
dangerous laws in states like Texas.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Registering and organizing young voters

Powered by People volunteers are putting in the work to reach eligible but
unregistered young voters. Last week, I visited Angelo State with a team
of Powered by People volunteers to talk to and register students to vote.

We’re on college campuses registering students and ensuring they have all
the information they need to participate in the 2024 elections.

Friend, the intensity of this race is growing week by week with more national attention and more nationwide Republican money coming into this race.
Before I continue, you need to know: our End of Month Fundraising Deadline is tomorrow, and reaching our goal is important to continue connecting with voters across South Texas. Can you chip in today to help us reach our Digital End of Month Fundraising Goal of $12,322? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240429_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240429_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
Growing up, I learned the values of hard work and resilience from my family and our community.
That's why despite the growing challenges in this race, I remain determined to push through until the end.
On the other hand, my opponent's under scrutiny from the FEC with reports surfacing about questionable financial practices, including illegally pocketing donor money.
In this race, it's clear that my opponent's self-dealing and catering to extremist Republicans will do more harm than good.
I will never stop prioritizing our community over personal gain and extremism , which is why I'm asking you for help to build our grassroots movement to 1️⃣ protect our healthcare, 2️⃣ support our public schools, and 3️⃣ invest in vital infrastructure improvements for South Texas.
Friend, with so much on the line, it's critical we don't take our foot off the gas in what last time was the CLOSEST congressional race in Texas. With a slim Republican majority in Congress, ours is a MUST-WIN seat to take back the House. Can you help us show the strength of our coalition by helping us reach our End of Month Fundraising Goal with a donation today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240429_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
JOIN OUR EFFORTS [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240429_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
With gratitude,
Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240429_em_fr_b1_VG_initial [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240429_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.
