subject: If I’m not fighting for my family, who will?
body:
I always had a lot of fear and anxiety growing up in a mixed status family. | | | Peter: I always had a lot of fear and anxiety growing up in a mixed status family. I knew I was safe, but I was so scared that any day would be the day I’d get the call that my parents were detained by ICE. Every time my parents went to work, went grocery shopping, or left the house, it was a constant fear that lived in the back of my mind. That’s why I started to speak up. **If I’m not fighting for my family, who will?** And the same goes for our community: **If we’re not fighting for the future we want, who will?** I envision a bright future for my community: safety from deportation, a pathway to citizenship, access to higher education and in-state tuition, and more. This future is possible, but only with the support of this community coming together to make it happen. There’s a role for everyone in the movement — organizers, allies, and grassroots donors like you. **We need your help to make my vision of the future a reality. Team,

It’s Raja Krishnamoorthi – Congressman for Illinois’ 8th District. I’ve had the honor of representing this district since being elected on November 8th, 2016.

This was also the day that our democracy and the face of politics changed forever – it was the day Donald Trump was elected as President.

Over my past four terms in Congress, I have seen firsthand the destruction that Donald Trump, his rhetoric, and his extremist MAGA agenda have caused — and the further destruction that his loyal supporters have caused on his behalf.

The only way we can combat the Trump sycophants at the federal level is to ensure that we have strong Democrats fighting for our values at the state, local, and county levels. That’s where IDCCA comes in.

IDCCA recruits, trains, and supports Democratic candidates and campaign staff running for office – ensuring the future of our party and electing people who are committed to protecting the rights that MAGA extremists are putting at risk.

The work IDCCA does is critically important at this time in history, and that’s why I’m reaching out to ask you to make a contribution to support their efforts. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

If you want to stop the GOP’s crusade against our public libraries, contribute $10 so we can keep working to fight back against the corrupt Republicans attacking libraries and our most important public square, our democracy.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83980674/470097850/-1734779286?refcode=4-29-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyNWRmZWIyLTY4MDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bGiF2HUDXQe73E-nILGaePq0buyfACrmSl3kX7oWLDE=)** The GOP could be focusing their attacks on any number of issues, like Congressional corruption or attacks on our democracy, but instead they’re harassing librarians. Pancake Day in Racine, How Open Borders Impact Wisconsin, and 2024 Convention Fest. | | | | |

Do you want to know more about our campaign? Or do you want to know how you can get involved?
Send us an email at bryan@steilforwisconsin.com.
Here’s an update from another week on the campaign trail.
**Pancake Day in Racine** I spent my Saturday morning flipping pancakes at 68th Annual Pancake Day at Roma Lodge. It was great to see such a big crowd!
This weekend, I also got the chance to thank our grassroots volunteers who’re out in full force across the First District collecting nomination signatures. I’m grateful for all their hard work!
**How Open Borders Impact Wisconsin** I joined PBS Wisconsin to talk about the implications that open border policies are having on our communities.
Joe Biden’s open border policies affect every community in the United States, including places like the town of Whitewater, Wisconsin. Whitewater is a city of approximately 15,000 that has seen a rapid influx of roughly 1,000 migrants arriving primarily from Venezuela and Nicaragua over the last two years.
The dramatic increase in population has strained the city’s police department resources and prevented them from properly serving their residents.
[Click Here to Watch My Interview With PBS](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=157a5b823e&e=e907534017)
**Submit Your Application for Convention Fest in Milwaukee** In case you missed it, the Milwaukee Host Committee for the 2024 Republican National Convention unveiled key details about the 2024 Convention Fest.
Convention Fest will be a one-of-a-kind street festival experience in Milwaukee during the 2024 Republican National Convention. Convention Fest will take place during all four days of the Convention and will feature pop-up booths with some of the best food, drinks, and shopping that Wisconsin has to offer.
Convention Fest will also be another opportunity for local Wisconsin companies to showcase and sell their products and services to Convention guests who will be visiting Milwaukee from all over the country.
If you want to submit an application for your business to be featured at Convention Fest, then click the link below!
[Submit Your Application for Convention Fest](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=750c4adca5&e=e907534017)

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

subject: The full strength of our Squad is undeniable
body:
#

Hi there — AOC, Ayanna, Cori, Ilhan, Jamaal and Rashida here!
We’ll cut to the chase: **[All six of us are up for re-election this year — and we have some well-funded, MAGA-backed challengers to ward off.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-april24-svf.lUVdHx&refcode=em240429-2-t1t2&t=1&akid=1104%2E791427%2EU908Ld)**
We’ve grown so much since our Squad first got to Congress in 2018 — and yet our conviction has never wavered — to show up as true representatives of our communities, to inform policy rooted in justice and equity, and to lead with compassion.
Republicans are doing everything to unseat our Squad. But we won’t let them intimidate us into silence, or undo our hard-earned progressive wins.
The full strength of our Squad is undebatable. And the far-right knows it — that’s why they’re gearing up to throw everything they have, including a desperate $100 million, into unseating us. **Let’s make sure that doesn’t happen.**
**We know that, with you on our side, we’ll be able to accomplish even more in the future.** But the truth is, we need to have the resources, tools, and funding to protect our progress. And we’ll need all the support we can get if we want to keep advancing life-changing policies in Congress.
Reaching our April fundraising goal would show our opposition the true strength of our movement — and _make clear that we aren’t going anywhere. But we can’t do this without you._
**[If you stand with our Squad please chip in $6 — $1 per campaign — to help us close the gap on our $55,000 goal and continue Q2 in the strongest position possible.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-april24-svf.lUVdHx&refcode=em240429-2-t1t2&t=2&akid=1104%2E791427%2EU908Ld)
**[CONTRIBUTE $6](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-april24-svf.lUVdHx&refcode=em240429-2-t1t2&t=3&akid=1104%2E791427%2EU908Ld)**
Thank you,
The Squad Victory Fund

Paid for by The Squad Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, Rooted in Community Leadership PAC, Cori Bush for Congress, and Bowman for Congress.
The Squad Victory Fund
c/o Mele Brengarth & Associates LLC
PO Box 15845
Washington, DC 20003
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can **[unsubscribe here](https://act.ilhanomar.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?source=em-footer&t=4&akid=1104%2E791427%2EU908Ld)**. You can also **[sign up to receive fewer emails](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=5&akid=1104%2E791427%2EU908Ld)**.
Submit this form to [**update your contact information**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/update-contact-info/source=em-footer?t=6&akid=1104%2E791427%2EU908Ld)
In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated as follows: 10% to each of Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, Rooted in Community Leadership PAC, Cori Bush for Congress, and Jamaal Bowman for Congress.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Cori Bush for Congress, and Jamaal Bowman for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

Email us: [**info@squadvictoryfund.com**](mailto:info@squadvictoryfund.com)

subject: How the Squad shifted the trajectory of American politics
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

This is a long but important email about what we’ve accomplished together
with all of you and the Squad so far, and why we need your support to
protect our progressive power in Congress. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jd-2.48vO86&refcode=em20240429-34552&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34552%2E1203867%2E7Gg7I7 ]I hope you’ll take a moment
to read it and pitch in whatever you can afford to help protect the Squad
in 2024 before tomorrow's midnight deadline.

Over the last three cycles, alongside so many, our movement has been
instrumental in building real power in the U.S. House by electing some of
the most progressive, diverse, working-class representatives Congress has
seen in our lifetime — leaders like Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, Summer Lee,
Ilhan Omar, Rashida Tlaib, and the rest of the Squad.

Despite all the odds stacked against us, we’ve not only succeeded in
electing these true representatives of the people – we have fundamentally
reset what we expect from our elected officials: the urgency they bring to
office and how much they are willing to put their political capital and
power on the line to fight for the most vulnerable among us. The Squad has
fundamentally shifted the trajectory of American politics and has done it
all on our behalf.

Each of these progressive champions has led the fight for Medicare for
All, a Green New Deal, a livable minimum wage, racial justice, student
debt relief, and so much more. While we continue the work to make some of
these bold, necessary policies a reality, the Squad has brought a whole
lot of good to their communities and the country at large.

During their time in Congress, the Squad has delivered more than $4
billion to their districts to fund infrastructure, K-12 public education,
affordable housing, firefighting, climate resilience, public transit,
health centers, senior housing, employment assistance, and so much more.

They’ve stood with striking workers on picket lines, demanded an extension
of the federal evictions moratorium during the pandemic, and pushed for
the largest investment in clean energy and climate action ever through the
Inflation Reduction Act.

They were also among the very first to introduce a ceasefire resolution
and call for peace and the release of all Palestinian and Israeli hostages
back in October, despite cruel attacks from colleagues on both sides of
the aisle.

As a result, the Squad has angered Republicans, billionaires, and war
hawks alike; that’s why AIPAC and their right-wing megadonor network are
spending $100 million against them this cycle to try removing them from
office.

Corporate PACs have spent millions against us in the past and failed to
beat our people power. These attacks are proof that what we’re doing is
working — so we can’t let them set us back this year.

That’s why Justice Democrats and more than ten progressive partner
organizations are rushing to raise $100,000 this month for the five Squad
members facing the toughest re-election fights.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jd-2.48vO86&refcode=em20240429-34552&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=34552%2E1203867%2E7Gg7I7 ]Can you split $5 or any amount right now to help us
raise what we need to protect the Squad before April ends?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jd-2.48vO86&refcode=em20240429-34552&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=34552%2E1203867%2E7Gg7I7 ]Contribute $5

Unlike the right-wing groups attacking us who are backed by corporate
interests and GOP millionaires, Justice Democrats and the Squad rely on
grassroots donations from regular people like you to make our work
possible.

Thank you for anything you can contribute to help the Squad accomplish
even more for our communities, country, and world. Together, we can and
will achieve the progress and justice we all deserve by protecting and
building our power.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240429-34552-footer&t=1022&refcode2=34552_1203867_7Gg7I7&akid=34552%2E1203867%2E7Gg7I7

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1023&akid=34552%2E1203867%2E7Gg7I7

Peter, as you may know, I was NASA Chief of Staff under President Obama.

At NASA, it was never about self-interest and party politics. Did we have our differences? Sure. But we worked together to solve problems and move the country forward.

That’s what we’re missing in Congress today, and there’s no bigger offender than my opponent Mike Garcia. His actions have shown he’s loyal to the Republican Party above all else – including the needs of our community:
* He’s voted for a national abortion ban, despite the vast majority of our community opposing it.
* He’s voted to give himself a pay raise, despite many in our district struggling to make ends meet.
* He’s voted in lock-step with the GOP, even when it’s against our community’s best interests.

CONTACT: Houston Keene

Nancy Dahlstrom Signs Pledge to Not Raise Taxes in Office

ANCHORAGE, AK -- Today, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom pledged to not
raise taxes while in office, signing onto Americans for Tax Reform's
Taxpayer Protection Pledge. For 29 years, Grover Norquist and ATR have
been holding politicians accountable when they say they will not raise
taxes on their communities while in office and do so anyway. Higher
taxes make life much harder for Alaskans, especially when a lot of
critical necessities are imported into the state.

Lt. Governor Dahlstrom is the first candidate in the race for Alaska's
sole congressional seat to sign such a pledge. By signing the Taxpayer
Protection Pledge on Monday, Dahlstrom joined the near-1,400 elected
officials who say no to more new taxes, and walk their talk.

"From gas pumps to grocery stores, Alaskans are hurting from
'Bidenomics.' Unfortunately, many candidates will promise to lower
taxes when they get into office, only to pull a fast one on the
hard-working people of their communities," Nancy Dahlstrom said in a
statement. "I signed the Taxpayer Protection Pledge because I am a
battle-tested conservative who keeps my promises. I will not raise
taxes on our hardworking Alaskans, and I am willing to put my name on
that promise. Joe Biden's failing economic policies, rubber-stamped by
Democrats in Congress including Mary Peltola, are forcing people to
make needless, tough decisions with their dollars that don't go as far.
I will work to get people's money working for them, not make them
overwork for their money."

body:
Interested in running for local office? Join us on May 7th.

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=good_party_x_forward_party_web&n=1)
---
Monday, April 29, 2024 | Peter -- Did you know that nearly 70% of local elections are uncontested? That means someone could be serving as an elected official in your community only because no one ran against them! Though 2024 is a critical federal election year, it’s also an unprecedented moment for leaders like you to have a voice in literally hundreds of thousands of local positions around the country. This opportunity is why Good Party and Forward Party are excited to announce an upcoming virtual event. In our webinar - ** _Path to Victory: Running for Local Office as an Independent in 2024 -_** our organizations will present our shared strategy to power independents & Forward Party candidates to victory in local elections nationwide. In only 90 minutes, we will walk you through the process of sizing up the opportunity, launching a run, and executing our playbook for a winning campaign. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=bOIh4UEYYsyl_IjgdMbLEtpLfqgot8tGb9rcTtU5nhOB9pdcFFzrUFzcVVSRqkz1&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=good_party_x_forward_party_web&n=2 "Join us on May 7th!") [Join us on May 7th!](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=bOIh4UEYYsyl_IjgdMbLEtpLfqgot8tGb9rcTtU5nhOB9pdcFFzrUFzcVVSRqkz1&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=good_party_x_forward_party_web&n=2)
---
Taught by campaign experts from both groups with a combined 80 years of local campaigning experience, this event is for anyone who has ever considered running for office. We'll demystify the process, showing you how anyone can build a campaign that can result in a win.
_We know you share our values of putting the interests of your community above ideology and working to heal divides rather than exploit them. That is why we want_ _YOU_ _to run for office._
The opportunity this year is enormous, and our communities need passionate people like you to make real change. We can’t wait to see you there!
Thanks,
Lindsey

clean_body: Interested in running for local office? Join us on May 7th. | | Monday, April 29, 2024 | Peter -- Did you know that nearly 70% of local elections are uncontested? That means someone could be serving as an elected official in your community only because no one ran against them! Though 2024 is a critical federal election year, it’s also an unprecedented moment for leaders like you to have a voice in literally hundreds of thousands of local positions around the country. This opportunity is why Good Party and Forward Party are excited to announce an upcoming virtual event. In our webinar - Path to Victory: Running for Local Office as an Independent in 2024 - our organizations will present our shared strategy to power independents & Forward Party candidates to victory in local elections nationwide. In only 90 minutes, we will walk you through the process of sizing up the opportunity, launching a run, and executing our playbook for a winning campaign. | "Join us on May 7th!" Taught by campaign experts from both groups with a combined 80 years of local campaigning experience, this event is for anyone who has ever considered running for office. We'll demystify the process, showing you how anyone can build a campaign that can result in a win. We know you share our values of putting the interests of your community above ideology and working to heal divides rather than exploit them. That is why we want YOU to run for office. The opportunity this year is enormous, and our communities need passionate people like you to make real change. We can’t wait to see you there! Thanks, Lindsey Lindsey Williams Drath "forwardparty.com" Copyright © 2024 Forward Party®, all rights reserved. These Democracy Champions are on the frontlines of protecting the freedom to vote and pushing back against MAGA extremists from the General Assembly to counties and cities all across the state. They’ll work hard to ensure Georgians can safely and freely cast their ballots so that every voice is heard and our elections reflect the will of the people.

Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my time in Congress serving North Carolina’s 8th District. Or you may be coming across me for the first time. Either way, I’m glad to be reaching out to you, and I think this could be the beginning of a great relationship. My name is Dan Bishop, and I’m running for Attorney General for North Carolina with the intention of bringing Law and Order back to the Tar Heel State.

**[This email is a bit longer and I hope you’ll read through it. I’m going to ask you for a donation to my campaign at the end of this email, but let me explain why it’s so crucial you join my team first.](http://links.classicconservatives.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3e67810cd106466b8329f05dd94c2dfe&_e=bARGkE-UHv1hntOLfZCN_-pBwIigdXTQrwcW45Hvt_GVXoyV_7DECbpLstPYy1-3Rdx6N4RYZh4KL1FytLpGiC7LdqSdxyLd9KEHJnm0YJAv3ZqQxJyoKVu_AQSwUF76ikVmHyVt-wN1rby1uSSrOBIRMVNfQzCktI_FOYzPxtg-XUFhZhh34-nph1XAGr3BuUb3ZoNSu1u0_-WyMxrCWZkgkCJQChArHWNza5MZf5JUsWJnWIi9xZg9ihkpUwLGQr0w6tGiH3985AurvbjVlX-D-v0FK6timE0PWf6g3S3lZEwaGdxLI7s3npG0caFQmV9tD7HhF1JIVN4LQBVtB5NB6iq0GtofK-iA468QLSFX5h3Ye6-RpmZ6Y2rheQJmLRJxUwo-R36VVfvvTgO13w%3D%3D)**

I was born and raised with my four siblings in North Carolina by my parents, Kaytee and Bud. They didn’t come from much, but they pushed me towards an education and instilled a hard work ethic. With a passion for law and justice, I earned my JD at UNC Chappel Hill. I then went on to marry my wife of 25 years (and going), Jo; we raised our son, Jack, who’s currently following in his dad’s footsteps as he’s working to attain his law degree.

As a lawyer, I’m very proud of my track record. I was a commercial litigator for nearly three decades, where I was voted 10 times to Business NC’s “Legal Elite” and was selected 7 times by “Super Lawyers.” I was tenacious as a litigator and handled complex cases. But, I finally felt that it was time to help a broader scope of North Carolinians and decided to run for Congress.

In Congress, I’ve been one of the toughest and most outspoken conservatives, challenging the radical left and holding my fellow Republicans accountable. As a member of the judiciary committee and the subcommittee on the weaponization of the federal government, I fought the Biden administration’s dangerous policies and exposed the federal government’s abuses against the Trump presidency.

Now, I’m running for Attorney General to defend the rule of law and protect North Carolina. I believe Democrats like Roy Cooper and Josh Stein have abused the state’s top law enforcement office by turning it into a stepping stone for higher office and a platform to spread liberal propaganda. I’m putting my foot down, demanding respect for the office of Attorney General, and bringing Law and Order back to our great state.

**All that to say, I have a track record of fighting the good fight. And I hope you’ll join my team. The good fight is not free; running a campaign gets expensive, having to reach voters across the state, taking care of campaign staffers with food and gas, and running ads on TV.** **[That’s why I’m humbly asking you for a donation of whatever you can afford.](http://links.classicconservatives.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3e67810cd106466b8329f05dd94c2dfe&_e=bARGkE-UHv1hntOLfZCN_-pBwIigdXTQrwcW45Hvt_GVXoyV_7DECbpLstPYy1-3Rdx6N4RYZh4KL1FytLpGiC7LdqSdxyLd9KEHJnm0YJAv3ZqQxJyoKVu_AQSwUF76ikVmHyVt-wN1rby1uSSrOBIRMVNfQzCktI_FOYzPxtg-XUFhZhh34-nph1XAGr3BuUb3ZoNSu1u0_-WyMxrCWZkgkCJQChArHWNza5MZf5JUsWJnWIi9xZg9ihkpUwLGsdOXUt3Itf3Z3ba2ai9QHvI720pW5lngZAaMtT2xzQ6anj3pVPrvwE2tQ4XcNidio1-U3uppm97gWpoe6MK9ZgLds8EjA9XvPubrTqRVvbQCR18Ge56wSoDr82dhjl_Vh2TAqV5f5eo_7J5yqsXLgw%3D%3D)**

If you’ve gotten this far, I want to personally thank you for reading this email. Maybe it means you’ve been a supporter for quite some time. Or maybe it means you’re intrigued by my story and also believe in Law and Order over Chaos and Disorder. **[Either way, can you send my campaign just $1 or more to help me out?](http://links.classicconservatives.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3e67810cd106466b8329f05dd94c2dfe&_e=bARGkE-UHv1hntOLfZCN_-pBwIigdXTQrwcW45Hvt_GVXoyV_7DECbpLstPYy1-3Rdx6N4RYZh4KL1FytLpGiC7LdqSdxyLd9KEHJnm0YJAv3ZqQxJyoKVu_AQSwUF76ikVmHyVt-wN1rby1uSSrOBIRMVNfQzCktI_FOYzPxtg-XUFhZhh34-nph1XAGr3BuUb3ZoNSu1u0_-WyMxrCWZkgkCJQChArHWNza5MZf5JUsWJnWIi9xZg9ihkpUwLGxNnfasZjf9YXWXn97AX-0CoFzAimsa0NnyabBczQo74dU6FkSagqZ_Ukmgf87TaL8JXL1Cw58cKPmcyHyzo4Y_rPZDYV82NCerlIZI5YG3dnn-JpXOAT8wL7-amp1TuYx-d1-xSMWWPPX-JKX3oOPg%3D%3D)**

Thank you,

name: Andrew Yang
subject: A Hidden Opportunity
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=4134990e85&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| Hello, I hope that the Spring is off to a great start for you and yours. I just spoke at the Hudson Valley Ideas Fast this weekend and it was a lovely experience.

There’s a lot of frustration with our political process right now, for good reason. Congress, after months of delay, just passed an aid package. But it’s important to take advantage of opportunities to improve our leadership when they do come up. Andy Kim is one example – he’ll make a tremendous U.S. Senator from New Jersey as a true voice of the people.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=51827e0f0d&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
There’s another massive opportunity to install a high-quality U.S. Senator that most everyone is overlooking. That is the race to replace Mitt Romney in Utah.

Mitt Romney announced last year that he would not run for re-election, citing his advanced age and a desire to pass the torch to the next generation. As you’d imagine, this set off a rush of candidates to replace him. 11 candidates have declared in the Republican primary. Of these, the vast majority – 8 - have endorsed Donald Trump.

The ninth? [John Curtis](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=32bd0d2a8d&e=0f227c2ae3), a four-term member of Congress. John is his own person. “If they’re expecting me to be Mitt Romney, I’m going to disappoint them. If they’re expecting me to be Mike Lee, I’m going to disappoint them. I’m John Curtis, and I’m really happy with who that is and what I’ve been able to do and accomplish.” Among those accomplishments, John founded the Conservative Climate Caucus for Republicans who believe that climate change is a problem and want to help address it. John has his beliefs and is willing to stand up for them.

“I thought long and hard about running for this office. And I became convinced that it’s the best way I can serve.” John and I had lunch together recently and he struck me as someone of character and leadership. Despite his service in Washington, he seemed very circumspect in taking on this race. Other members of Congress I’ve spoken to – even those who disagree with him on some fronts – rave about his ability to work together.

The Republican primary in Utah is on June 25th. Who would you rather have, a Romney-esque leader who believes in climate change and isn’t bending the knee to Trump or one of the eight candidates who has already endorsed Trump? This is a rare opportunity because, in such a crowded field, someone like John could emerge from the primary and be on a glide path straight to the Senate.

One frustration I have with Democrats is that they act like all Republicans are the same, sometimes while actually backing election deniers in primaries to increase their own chances in the general. Here, the opportunity is to back a non-Maga Senator who can help provide a bulwark against the extremes of his own party. That’s a big deal. And the Democrats will be uncompetitive in this particular race in November.

I’ve donated to John and I hope you will consider [doing](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b576671315&e=0f227c2ae3) so as well. Let your friends in Utah know about his race. We have to take advantage of opportunities when they arise and leaders like John don’t come along every day.

To see what Forward is up to in your area click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=66d99140fe&e=0f227c2ae3). To better understand why our political process is so dysfunctional, pick up [Forward: Notes on the Future of our Democracy](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=edf9f3a95e&e=0f227c2ae3). And I just found out my TED Talk comes out on May 7th next week – pumped to share it with the world!

---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c6c60a8409&e=0f227c2ae3)

body:
A former top NRA official told The New York Times: “The NRA is little more than a shell of itself.”
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240429-1&t=1&akid=623%2E587540%2ED_QfoI)
One thing is for sure, Peter: **The once mighty NRA is on its last legs.**
What once appeared to be an unstoppable force in American politics, the NRA has seen a mass exodus of over one million members, corruption charges, and millions of dollars in legal fees — meanwhile their overall revenue dropped 52% since 2016.1

body:
Record-breaking amounts of outside spending are heading to Montana, and going up against their fundraising machine will be the toughest fight of my life.

| Hey Peter, hope you’re well.

It’s planting season here in Big Sandy, Montana.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83986814/470116025/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-04-29_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEyY2ZhMjZhLTc1MDYtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=X52BqnWiU2YqVWORXitaeTZ2tbxod6WSXLGodQAyZ9Q=)
Sharla and I have been planting on the same farm for 46 years. Three generations of our family called this land home, and my work here is non-negotiable. It keeps me grounded, and I think it makes me a better senator for Montana.

You learn the value of hard work and accountability growing up on the farm. Nothing will get done if you wait around for someone else to do the job. **The key to a successful harvest is hard work during planting season, and Peter, we’re running this grassroots campaign the same way.**

# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1206%2E62735%2EbpxDvT)
Hey Peter,
I’m forwarding my team’s email from earlier because our campaign just crossed a critical milestone: **99 days to the Michigan Senate primary.**
To mark this occasion, our offices across Michigan — including two new offices we just opened in Muskegon and Grand Rapids — are doing canvass launches to spread our campaign’s reach. We can’t afford to lose steam at this stage, so we’re fanning out across the community to meet voters where they’re at. That’s how we’re going to win this thing.
But look, I won’t sugarcoat it — we’re facing an uphill battle here. Only with your support can we keep our movement growing and _finally_ secure the people-first leadership we deserve in Washington.
**Our critical end-of-month fundraising deadline is tomorrow at midnight, so please:[Click here to give any amount that works for you to help us run the strongest ground game possible over these next 99 days >>>](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1411?t=2&akid=1206%2E62735%2EbpxDvT)**
Thank you - HH
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1411?t=3&akid=1206%2E62735%2EbpxDvT)

**Begin forwarded message:**
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Team Harper [(info@e.hillharper.com)](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1411?t=4&akid=1206%2E62735%2EbpxDvT)
Date: Apr 29, 2024
Subject: The countdown begins: 99 days!!! ⏰
> Can you believe it, Peter?
> Today marks **_99 days until the Michigan Senate primary!_** That’s 99 days left until everything Hill has been advocating for — universal healthcare, environmental justice, cleaning up government corruption — goes head to head with the establishment at the ballot box.
> **This is big stuff we’re talking about! Let’s take a quick trip down memory lane to see how far we’ve come ⤵️**
> **_July 10th, 2023_**
> The day Hill launched his grassroots campaign for Michigan’s open Senate seat! He’s so proud of how much we’ve grown and the endorsements we’ve earned since then. Together, we’re working towards a brighter future in Michigan and beyond.
> **_February 16th, 2024_**
> The day Hill submitted the required nominating petitions and officially filed to get his name on the ballot — the first candidate in this race to do so! It took a lot of grassroots volunteer support to get to this point, which makes it an even more special milestone on the road to the primary.
> **_March 31st, 2024_**
> The day our campaign stared down our biggest fundraising challenge to date — the first FEC quarterly deadline of 2024 — and it’s thanks to you that we filed a strong report. Hill isn’t taking a cent of corporate PAC money, so your support is _critical_ to our campaign.
> **_August 6th, 2024_**
> The big one: Primary Day! The outcome will determine who will face the GOP frontrunner, and it’s going to take _every single member_ of this grassroots team to beat the establishment and send Hill to the November General Election. Which brings us back to...
> **_April 29th, 2024_**
> Today, we’re asking Hill’s supporters to come together like never before and support Hill’s people-first candidacy. **[With 99 days left until the primary — and our campaign’s urgent end-of-month fundraising deadline tomorrow — will you chip in any amount to propel Hill to victory at the ballot box?](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1411?t=5&akid=1206%2E62735%2EbpxDvT)**
> _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

> We can’t tell you how much your support means to Hill. Thanks for chipping in!
> \- Team Harper

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Every person matters in this effort. Don't wait. ---
| | As District Attorney, it is my responsibility to keep our families safe, as well as alert them to potential threats to their quality of life. In fact, it would be a dereliction of my duty to remain silent.
That is why I feel compelled to address the “behind closed door arraignment” being perpetrated on you with the pending appointment of Bob Morris to the Hernando City Court bench. You may remember Bob Morris, who voted for Joe Biden in 2020 and donated to gun-grabbing Democrat liberals in Congress.
Let me be clear: Such an appointment would be VERY bad for the City of Hernando and DeSoto County – believe me!
As a municipal judge, Mr. Morris would possess the authority to determine bail and preside over preliminary hearings for felony cases. History shows that judges affiliated with the likes of Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi tend to exhibit leniency towards criminals, resulting in low bails and a prioritization of "rehabilitation" over punishment. This leniency permits violent offenders to freely roam the streets with minimal consequences for their actions. Just look at the mess in Memphis. A Judge there recently released a felon on ROR bail who subsequently murdered a policeman.
This appointment would directly undermine my efforts as Distrct Attorney to establish high bonds for felons, so that we do not become SOUTH MEMPHIS. This is not the trajectory we want to go!
And remember, DeSoto County and Hernando already issued a HUGE “no thanks” to Bob Morris for District Attorney for all these reasons and more.
Keeping us safe in DeSoto County is my top priority, and I need your help to tell our city leaders (Alderman and Mayor) loud and clear – Bob Morris is the wrong guy for the job!
---

It's true- most of our elected officials actually hate us.

Democrats for sure- but don't kid yourself, there's just as many Republicans too.

It's one of the biggest problems our movement faces right now.

They pretend to be Pro Trump. They pretend to be America First.

So when I meet a true America First patriot, I make it a priority to do everything I can to help them defeat the D.C uniparty & drain the swamp.

__**Today, that patriot is Mayra Flores.**__

Mayra's running in the biggest race in America- the one seat our movement can & should win.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Price gouging is served
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This is absurd.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2152%2E4032634%2E2Y5iH5)
---
You know when you’re ordering dinner on DoorDash or UberEats, where you see the total price as you add food to your cart, but when it’s time to check out, the total is three times more? This is intentional. These companies are taking advantage of customers — tacking on confusing and inexplicable “service” and “delivery” and “regulatory” fees at the very end of the checkout process, when your order is so close you can taste it. And that doesn’t include tax or tip yet. All together, totals can come out to be more than double of what the actual order is. This is a matter of big corporations gaining too much power in their industry and taking advantage of American families and workers — all in order to line their CEOs' pockets with millions. On top of price gouging consumers, food delivery companies have also historically underpaid delivery drivers and pocketed a major cut on commissions from restaurants. So Senators Bob Casey, Ben Ray Luján, and I just sent a letter to DoorDash and UberEats to call out their use of hidden junk fees to take advantage of American consumers trying to put food on the table while balancing busy schedules. They need to be transparent in their business practices and show us where these mysterious service and delivery fees go. I’m pushing to prevent these companies from taking advantage of customers while lining the pockets of their CEOs. [**Add your name if you believe companies like DoorDash and UberEats should be held accountable for overcharging customers looking to put food on the table, underpaying drivers trying to make a living, and bullying small businesses with commission rates.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-deliveryapps/?source=EMZ19Y_FIN_E_20240429_V1S1&t=8&akid=2152%2E4032634%2E2Y5iH5) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-deliveryapps/?source=EMZ19Y_FIN_E_20240429_V1S1&t=9&akid=2152%2E4032634%2E2Y5iH5)
---
One would hope that these companies would at least reinvest their revenue in delivery workers’ compensation or cutting down frivolous fees for consumers. But we can’t bank on just hope. Here’s where we can see that money is actually going:
* In February of this year, DoorDash announced a $1.1 billion round of stock buybacks.
* In March of this year, UberEats initiated a $7 billion stock buyback.
* In 2020, DoorDash went public and had the highest-paid CEO in Silicon Valley, with a total compensation of nearly $413 million.
* Last year, Uber paid its CEO more than $24 million.

And it’s not just consumers who are fronting the bill for these excessive salaries and stock buybacks.
According to Vox, these companies continue to underpay delivery drivers — without whom there wouldn’t be a business. In fact, about half the amount they make on each trip comes from tips. In certain cities like New York and Seattle, where recent laws require delivery apps to pay drivers a minimum wage, an additional “regulatory fee” is added and passed right back to customers.
Small businesses are paying the price too. These companies take as much as 30% from each order that is placed through their service.
This is what happens when big companies dominate a market and go unchecked — they’re able to overcharge, provide lower-quality service, treat workers and small businesses poorly, while their CEOs and executives take home exorbitant amounts of money. It doesn’t have to be this way.
So far, Senator Casey and I have reintroduced the Price Gouging Prevention Act, which would protect consumers and prohibit corporate price gouging. We have also introduced the Shrinkflation Prevention Act, which would crack down on corporations that deceive their customers by selling smaller sizes of their products without lowering the price.
I’m going to continue fighting these corporations with every tool available to make sure American consumers, workers, and small businesses aren’t hurt and taken advantage of. [**Add your name if you agree that these fees have gotten out of hand and these companies must be held accountable.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-deliveryapps/?source=EMZ19Y_FIN_E_20240429_V1S1&t=10&akid=2152%2E4032634%2E2Y5iH5)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

clean_body: This is absurd. | | | You know when you’re ordering dinner on DoorDash or UberEats, where you see the total price as you add food to your cart, but when it’s time to check out, the total is three times more? This is intentional. These companies are taking advantage of customers — tacking on confusing and inexplicable “service” and “delivery” and “regulatory” fees at the very end of the checkout process, when your order is so close you can taste it. And that doesn’t include tax or tip yet. All together, totals can come out to be more than double of what the actual order is. This is a matter of big corporations gaining too much power in their industry and taking advantage of American families and workers — all in order to line their CEOs' pockets with millions. On top of price gouging consumers, food delivery companies have also historically underpaid delivery drivers and pocketed a major cut on commissions from restaurants. So Senators Bob Casey, Ben Ray Luján, and I just sent a letter to DoorDash and UberEats to call out their use of hidden junk fees to take advantage of American consumers trying to put food on the table while balancing busy schedules. They need to be transparent in their business practices and show us where these mysterious service and delivery fees go. I’m pushing to prevent these companies from taking advantage of customers while lining the pockets of their CEOs. | One would hope that these companies would at least reinvest their revenue in delivery workers’ compensation or cutting down frivolous fees for consumers. But we can’t bank on just hope. Here’s where we can see that money is actually going: In February of this year, DoorDash announced a $1.1 billion round of stock buybacks. In March of this year, UberEats initiated a $7 billion stock buyback. In 2020, DoorDash went public and had the highest-paid CEO in Silicon Valley, with a total compensation of nearly $413 million. Last year, Uber paid its CEO more than $24 million. And it’s not just consumers who are fronting the bill for these excessive salaries and stock buybacks. According to Vox, these companies continue to underpay delivery drivers — without whom there wouldn’t be a business. In fact, about half the amount they make on each trip comes from tips. In certain cities like New York and Seattle, where recent laws require delivery apps to pay drivers a minimum wage, an additional “regulatory fee” is added and passed right back to customers. Small businesses are paying the price too. These companies take as much as 30% from each order that is placed through their service. This is what happens when big companies dominate a market and go unchecked — they’re able to overcharge, provide lower-quality service, treat workers and small businesses poorly, while their CEOs and executives take home exorbitant amounts of money. It doesn’t have to be this way. So far, Senator Casey and I have reintroduced the Price Gouging Prevention Act, which would protect consumers and prohibit corporate price gouging. We have also introduced the Shrinkflation Prevention Act, which would crack down on corporations that deceive their customers by selling smaller sizes of their products without lowering the price. I’m going to continue fighting these corporations with every tool available to make sure American consumers, workers, and small businesses aren’t hurt and taken advantage of. body:
Tomorrow marks seven days until the May Primary. As the election approaches, our efforts to connect with Hoosiers across Indiana continue to ramp up!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

Tomorrow marks seven days until the May Primary. As the election approaches, our efforts to connect with communities across Indiana continue to ramp up! I'm hitting the road this week to meet with voters like you, listen to your concerns, and rally Hoosiers to get out and vote on May 7.

Join me and local elected officials at one (or all!) of the events listed below and together, let's get out the vote!!

** VOLUNTEER CALLOUT: Join Team Crouch on Election Day!
------------------------------------------------------------

You have the power to make a difference! Join our team on Election Day and help us make history in Indiana.
Distribute Signs (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdKMgQORmL8woOQN4gGy6S9BB1LHIGy95MUaBHXnfPGbekVBA/viewform?usp=sf_link&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Work the Polls (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd9Z6yLZ7jQ6tr9Ii8N4YhK5Ny80U2CwXfGwmg3CtbDhHrFRw/viewform?usp=sf_link&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN THE NEWS: S (https://indianacapitalchronicle.com/2024/04/26/suzanne-crouch-seeks-governorship-for-the-voiceless/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) uzanne Crouch seeks governorship for the voiceless (https://indianacapitalchronicle.com/2024/04/26/suzanne-crouch-seeks-governorship-for-the-voiceless/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

As governor, I’ll be a voice for the voiceless, for people who have no one standing up for them and who can’t afford the high-power, highly-paid lobbyists who roam the hallways at the Statehouse.

I’m committed to realizing a vision for Indiana’s future that’s both visionary and executable.
https://indianacapitalchronicle.com/2024/04/26/suzanne-crouch-seeks-governorship-for-the-voiceless/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ARTICLE (https://indianacapitalchronicle.com/2024/04/26/suzanne-crouch-seeks-governorship-for-the-voiceless/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN THE NEWS: As Noblesville mayor, I've seen why Suzanne Crouch is the best choice for Indiana governor (https://www.indystar.com/story/opinion/columnists/2024/04/23/chris-jensen-no-one-cares-more-about-hoosiers-than-suzanne-crouch/73355192007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you, Mayor Chris Jensen, for your support and confidence in my leadership.

As Governor, I'll continue to promote local control because every Hoosier, regardless of how close they live to Indianapolis, should be able to have a voice in their government and the decisions impacting their community.
https://www.indystar.com/story/opinion/columnists/2024/04/23/chris-jensen-no-one-cares-more-about-hoosiers-than-suzanne-crouch/73355192007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

------------------------------------------------------------

I recently shared where I stand on key policy issues facing Indiana with Axios. Check it out 👇
https://www.axios.com/local/indianapolis/2024/04/19/meet-suzanne-crouch-gubernatorial-candidate?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** IN THE NEWS: Crouch Stresses Experience for Governor (https://www.heraldbulletin.com/elections/crouch-stresses-experience-for-governor/article_a5ff21d8-00ba-11ef-a2b4-434ed4d63fb0.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Met with community leaders in Elwood to discuss the challenges facing our state and the solutions we need. As your next Governor, I'll bring real-world experience and a proven record of getting things done.
https://www.heraldbulletin.com/elections/crouch-stresses-experience-for-governor/article_a5ff21d8-00ba-11ef-a2b4-434ed4d63fb0.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** May is Mental Health Awareness Month
------------------------------------------------------------

The mental health crisis facing our state is undeniable. I️ recently released a TV ad addressing this issue and how, under my leadership, ensuring Hoosiers have access to affordable mental health care will be a priority.

This week will mark the beginning of May, which is Mental Health Awareness Month. Please take a moment to check in on your friends and neighbors.

If you or someone you know is in need of help, please visit www.in.gov/bewellindiana.
https://vimeo.com/923581936?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
WATCH THE AD (https://vimeo.com/923581936?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Five Lincoln Day Dinners Last Week
------------------------------------------------------------

I️ had the pleasure of attending five Lincoln Day Dinners last week, including:
* Boone County Lincoln Day Dinner
* Pike Township Lincoln Day Dinner
* Steuben County Lincoln Day Dinner
* Allen County Lincoln Day Dinner
* St. Joseph County Lincoln Day Dinner

A special thank you to the local Republican parties and party chairs, Debbie Ottinger, Rick Michael, Steve Shine, and Tyler Gillean, for their dedication to making these events a success.

** Last Gubernatorial Debate Before May Primary
------------------------------------------------------------

Big government, corporate media, and far-left ideologues are a three-headed monster that is eroding our liberties and turning our country into a top-down authoritarian state.

We need bold leaders who can get things done, and unlike my opponents, I don't need on-the-job training. I'm ready to deliver results on Day ONE.

** Hamilton County Sheriff Chaplaincy Breakfast
------------------------------------------------------------

Glad to support the Hamilton County Sheriff's Chaplaincy at last week's breakfast.

This is a faith-based nonprofit in which ministers and counselors serve our public safety and the community. This is important work that I'm proud to support.

** Alliance: A Forum of Indiana Business Leaders
------------------------------------------------------------

Last week at Butler University, I spoke to Indiana business leaders about my plan to Axe the Tax. It's time to put more money back in the pockets of hardworking Hoosiers and unleash our state's economic potential!

** IFRW Round Robin
------------------------------------------------------------

Over the weekend, I rallied with Lake County Republicans at a dynamic round-robin event hosted by the Indiana Federation of Republican Women! I'm not here to settle; under my leadership, I'll see that our state surges forward.

** ICYMI: Endorsements (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d3c25343e1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_24_02_48&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-d3c25343e1-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
Suzanne Crouch is the only gubernatorial candidate who has been endorsed by more than 175 past and present elected officials in Indiana. A full list of those endorsements can be found here. ** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------
With the challenges looming over Indiana and our nation, the significance of this election cannot be emphasized enough.

Your support is crucial in shaping the future of our state. Get involved, exercise your right to vote, and spread the word on social media. Together, let's keep pushing forward and make a meaningful difference for Indiana!

Onward and upward,

clean_body: Tomorrow marks seven days until the May Primary. As the election approaches, our efforts to connect with Hoosiers across Indiana continue to ramp up! Friends and fellow Hoosiers, Tomorrow marks seven days until the May Primary. As the election approaches, our efforts to connect with communities across Indiana continue to ramp up! I'm hitting the road this week to meet with voters like you, listen to your concerns, and rally Hoosiers to get out and vote on May 7. Join me and local elected officials at one (or all!) of the events listed below and together, let's get out the vote!! VOLUNTEER CALLOUT: Join Team Crouch on Election Day! You have the power to make a difference! Join our team on Election Day and help us make history in Indiana. Distribute Signs () Work the Polls () IN THE NEWS: S () uzanne Crouch seeks governorship for the voiceless () As governor, I’ll be a voice for the voiceless, for people who have no one standing up for them and who can’t afford the high-power, highly-paid lobbyists who roam the hallways at the Statehouse. I’m committed to realizing a vision for Indiana’s future that’s both visionary and executable. ARTICLE () IN THE NEWS: As Noblesville mayor, I've seen why Suzanne Crouch is the best choice for Indiana governor () Thank you, Mayor Chris Jensen, for your support and confidence in my leadership. As Governor, I'll continue to promote local control because every Hoosier, regardless of how close they live to Indianapolis, should be able to have a voice in their government and the decisions impacting their community. ARTICLE () IN THE NEWS: Meet Suzanne Crouch, gubernatorial candidate () I recently shared where I stand on key policy issues facing Indiana with Axios. Check it out 👇 ARTICLE () IN THE NEWS: Crouch Stresses Experience for Governor () Met with community leaders in Elwood to discuss the challenges facing our state and the solutions we need. As your next Governor, I'll bring real-world experience and a proven record of getting things done. ARTICLE () May is Mental Health Awareness Month The mental health crisis facing our state is undeniable. I️ recently released a TV ad addressing this issue and how, under my leadership, ensuring Hoosiers have access to affordable mental health care will be a priority. This week will mark the beginning of May, which is Mental Health Awareness Month. Please take a moment to check in on your friends and neighbors. If you or someone you know is in need of help, please visit www.in.gov/bewellindiana. WATCH THE AD () Five Lincoln Day Dinners Last Week I️ had the pleasure of attending five Lincoln Day Dinners last week, including: Boone County Lincoln Day Dinner Pike Township Lincoln Day Dinner Steuben County Lincoln Day Dinner Allen County Lincoln Day Dinner St. Joseph County Lincoln Day Dinner A special thank you to the local Republican parties and party chairs, Debbie Ottinger, Rick Michael, Steve Shine, and Tyler Gillean, for their dedication to making these events a success. Last Gubernatorial Debate Before May Primary Big government, corporate media, and far-left ideologues are a three-headed monster that is eroding our liberties and turning our country into a top-down authoritarian state. We need bold leaders who can get things done, and unlike my opponents, I don't need on-the-job training. I'm ready to deliver results on Day ONE. Hamilton County Sheriff Chaplaincy Breakfast Glad to support the Hamilton County Sheriff's Chaplaincy at last week's breakfast. This is a faith-based nonprofit in which ministers and counselors serve our public safety and the community. This is important work that I'm proud to support. Alliance: A Forum of Indiana Business Leaders Last week at Butler University, I spoke to Indiana business leaders about my plan to Axe the Tax. It's time to put more money back in the pockets of hardworking Hoosiers and unleash our state's economic potential! IFRW Round Robin Over the weekend, I rallied with Lake County Republicans at a dynamic round-robin event hosted by the Indiana Federation of Republican Women! I'm not here to settle; under my leadership, I'll see that our state surges forward. ICYMI: Endorsements () Suzanne Crouch is the only gubernatorial candidate who has been endorsed by more than 175 past and present elected officials in Indiana. A full list of those endorsements can be found here. () Last but not least... With the challenges looming over Indiana and our nation, the significance of this election cannot be emphasized enough. Your support is crucial in shaping the future of our state. Get involved, exercise your right to vote, and spread the word on social media. Together, let's keep pushing forward and make a meaningful difference for Indiana! Onward and upward, Let's keep the conversation going! Follow me on social to keep up with the campaign. Tap the "Get Involved" button below to get hands-on with the campaign, request yard signs, host an event and more. GET INVOLVED () Show Your Support - Get Suzanne Crouch Merchandise! As our campaign gains momentum, I'm excited to introduce a way for you to show your support and wear your pride for Indiana on your sleeve (literally)! | | April 29, 2024

Dear Friend, Inflation is skyrocketing, college campuses are becoming hotbeds of hate, our borders remain insecure, homelessness is out of control, and crime rates continue to trouble our communities. The real question is, who has the answers?

**_According to a recent CNN poll, Americans believe that Republicans have the answer._** Our track record of championing free markets, fiscal responsibility, strong national defense, tough-on-crime policies, and secure borders speaks volumes about our commitment to real solutions.

As you know, I'm Michael Maher, and I'm running for U.S. Congress in California's 21st district to bring new opportunities, resources, and change through conservative values. I'm a local business owner, educated here in the Valley and abroad. I'm a veteran of the U.S. Navy and former FBI Special Agent who not only understands the troubles we are facing but has the passion and real world experience to lead our community to a better tomorrow.

But I can't do it alone. I need your endorsement and contribution to secure victory in November.

I am proud to have the support of influential leaders like _**former National Security Adviser Robert O’Brien, Congressman John Duarte, Congressman Tom McClintock, former California Secretary of State Bill Jones, and many others.**_ The momentum is on our side, and our district is ready for a shift towards conservative principles.

However, we are a bit behind on meeting our April budget, and I need your help. Can you chip in with $20, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford?
---
| [DONATE NOW](https://michaelmaher.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6239b7d9cb3ad9388556be8be&id=7ce9a57394&e=1722d05e10 "DONATE NOW")
---
| Your contribution will help bolster our campaign efforts, reach independent and undecided voters, and show the far-left that conservative principles lead to real solutions. Our dedicated volunteers in Fresno and Tulare County are hitting the ground every weekend, talking to voters, and spreading our message. We cannot afford to let them down.

Please consider making a contribution to my campaign _**before midnight on April 30th**_ and _**forward this email to someone you know**_ who wants to see change in the right direction. Together, we will win this seat and make a lasting impact on our nation's future.

Sincerely,
---
|
---
| **Michael Maher**
Businessman | Veteran | Republican for Congress

|

| **About:**_ Michael Maher was raised in Tulare County where his parents still live and his father, who had been a pastor for over 30 years, continues to shepherd his church congregation in community. Michael and his wife Anne, who comes from a local multigenerational valley farming family, live in Fresno County where their two children attend local public school and where Michael owns and operates his aviation business. _

_Maher is a United States Navy veteran, and served abroad the USS Salt Lake City, a Los Angeles Class Fast Attack Submarine. Following the Navy, Michael graduated from Fresno Pacific University and then was accepted and graduated from FBI Academy in Quantico, Virginia. Michael served as a Special Agent for the Bureau working in the National Security Division. Additionally with the FBI, Maher was the Counterproliferation Coordinator for the Los Angeles Field Office which included responsibility in supervision of Chemical Weapons Inspections._

# Launching Imagine Better Media!!!

Today, I am proud to announce the launch of Imagine Better Media. In a time where modern media focuses on buzzwords and clickbait, we are building something better.
Imagine Better Media is a platform covering each story's history, problems, and solutions. We will cover the stories you care about, so let us know.
We will release three stories each week: a federal story, a state story, and a local story. These stories will come in three formats to follow in your preferred method. We will have videos, podcasts, and articles for each.
Please watch the full video below for all the details, follow us on social media, and consider becoming a paid subscriber on our website.
Thank you for your time.

| | **From The Chairman**
---
| | Europe is finally, finally waking up to the threat from Chinese espionage and intelligence operations. Three German citizens were recently [arrested](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=53c5748344fe484f9ebd3204ff0493bb&_e=P6vU3ZeOr-zN-iG1OS7dD9EaIcmEE6rcYMR8GhvnegP1vYACfwCIFeL_iXYCZT7U_QFZq_bacHW5U6JDpSr5XVQ80CgxC_uhn1WDToLZKRSlnU-7yimKhOjNJf2-mTCQllsGZHCKnimnYJae3055gnaIaA43jUxl8p6yje6fZ6Xt5jKcUPl_cUpsXuzvjS4t6QUnALsl0H7qW5pg5NOBYDt74lLNGhXOthvRJV4zRopTVAOoz4AVIjEqMjcKcsju) on suspicion of passing military secrets to Beijing. The UK recently [called out](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=53c5748344fe484f9ebd3204ff0493bb&_e=P6vU3ZeOr-zN-iG1OS7dD26EJrRskRjvjDLF_vBQtICIaS25i9_nYWGpETzA0yzthCriEjUA7XrXMmoydO_yDoCFzB0SedajShjfUpg7yQ6wbcjybSwFrJpO02fKMk12PX3HuI_bntvKZgXZ0HwZkYI_uKSdwaYTdTUAVsjPBoRF6QhtNkAjU2LkuCe7FyTuwMf_tw5r0SJIgoMXXBAIYUaAbRstMNLhxEFVVW2S0RKJ1elF5LOlnZw_VSgyZ5uut2I_NJ-nFXqb1O05d0e2ZRdNjAkuay2xGU_h7jANwak%3D) Beijing for hacking national infrastructure and databases and, separately, [charged](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=53c5748344fe484f9ebd3204ff0493bb&_e=P6vU3ZeOr-zN-iG1OS7dD9EaIcmEE6rcYMR8GhvnegOyEIertmU_r875T1XU0c2LTuRj6wDR60wAziNl28NhAd-oHVxg3CzD_LBUxAjUlBOxmT61njtpl3RYNVoE2s-N28BEUhZDR718WCvscOh2sx_24LP3NY_AhOktp8IwhY4tedZ6f3ZwpCpxt6nuooc6I5fyqumRvlhZ3lO55Cy5kQsKeEwZrmpmuOgz4NailkB2O96gbS3egFDLPXxG6uSC) a parliamentary staffer for allegedly spying for China. The Chinese Communist Party’s intelligence efforts are widespread and growing, and increasingly [shifting ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=53c5748344fe484f9ebd3204ff0493bb&_e=P6vU3ZeOr-zN-iG1OS7dD7LZ84k1QwYYmxo_aiM4xY5xFx6mVlBq4K4DBi7ZxcbwYrgBEfSvYi2wLMHx2wN53lxXvJ9JbeMhm6imVw-M7X5J6MGa6U0YW_4Pao8npO27NA43Qat2MetPDMxEQnQvdqeqT1ON7DAXXIkmL5yTSfVJu8WxvwATUzbQ0WBGHs-s77e1hLWNS7w2k5xeG6ZGSn_EFlrWtLVfZkshjnhj2ft4qqqqk9xqrb_OW363wbPK)towards influence operations—shaping public opinion and national conversations about issues of importance to Beijing. China’s reach into Europe is large and growing. Its business and economic ties give it incredible leverage in negotiations and disputes, and intelligence gives it a leg up—and we need to counter these efforts both here in America and working with our allies on the continent.

| | **We Need You!**
---
| | In order to win in November, Mike will need to spread his message from Detroit to Marquette, Saginaw to Kalamazoo, and everywhere in between!
